function positiveInt(name: string, fallback: number, max: number): number {
  const raw = process.env[name];
  if (raw === undefined || raw === "") return fallback;
  const value = Number(raw);
  if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 1 || value > max) {
    throw new Error(name + " debe ser un entero entre 1 y " + max + ".");
  }
  return value;
}

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

// Misma verificación de destino que seed-demo.ts, con SEED_VOLUMEN_CONFIRM.
function confirmDatabaseTarget() {
  const connection = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
  if (!connection) throw new Error("Falta DATABASE_URL. No se realizó la carga.");
  const url = new URL(connection);
  if (!["postgres:", "postgresql:"].includes(url.protocol)) {
    throw new Error("El seed requiere una conexión PostgreSQL.");
  }
  const database = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(1));
  if (!url.hostname || !database) throw new Error("DATABASE_URL debe indicar un host y una base de datos.");
  const target = url.hostname + ":" + (url.port || "5432") + "/" + database;
  if (process.env.SEED_VOLUMEN_CONFIRM !== target) {
    throw new Error(
      "Carga no autorizada. Destino detectado: " + target +
      ". Configurá SEED_VOLUMEN_CONFIRM con ese valor exacto para confirmar que es la base correcta.",
    );
  }
  console.log("Destino confirmado:", target);
}

async function clean(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
  // Las recetas, presentaciones e historial se borran en cascada.
  const products = await tx.product.deleteMany({ where: { accountId: ACCOUNT_ID, id: { startsWith: "32f" } } });
  const suppliers = await tx.supplier.deleteMany({ where: { accountId: ACCOUNT_ID, id: { startsWith: "32c" } } });
  const ingredients = await tx.ingredient.deleteMany({ where: { accountId: ACCOUNT_ID, id: { startsWith: "32b" } } });
  return { products: products.count, suppliers: suppliers.count, ingredients: ingredients.count };
}

function packageFor(unit: Unit): number {
  if (unit === "u") return pick([30, 180, 360]);
  if (unit === "l") return pick([1, 5, 12]);
  return pick([1, 5, 10, 25]);
}

function quantityFor(unit: Unit): Prisma.Decimal {
  if (unit === "u") return new Prisma.Decimal(Math.ceil(between(1, 6)).toFixed(3));
  return new Prisma.Decimal(between(0.01, 0.8).toFixed(3));
}

// Cada combinación sale en la línea habitual y en la línea económica: 352 nombres.
const LINES = ["", " (línea económica)"] as const;
const MAX_PRODUCTS = 352;

function productNames() {
  return LINES.flatMap((line) =>
    FAMILIES.flatMap((family) =>
      family.flavors.flatMap((flavor) =>
        family.formats.map((format) => ({ family, name: family.name + " " + flavor + " — " + format + line })),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

function shuffle<T>(items: T[]): T[] {
  for (let i = items.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
    [items[i], items[j]] = [items[j], items[i]];
  }
  return items;
}

// existingNames: nombres (en minúsculas) que la cuenta ya tiene fuera del volumen,
// para no chocar con el índice único case-insensitive.
function buildData(ingredientCount: number, productCount: number, existingNames: Set<string>) {
  const ingredients = shuffle(BASES.flatMap((base) => BRANDS.map((brand) => ({ ...base, brand }))))
    .filter((item) => !existingNames.has((item.name + " " + item.brand).toLowerCase()))
    .slice(0, ingredientCount)
    .map((item, index) => ({
      id: id(PREFIX.ingredient, index + 1),
      name: item.name + " " + item.brand,
      base: item.name,
      unit: item.unit,
      referenceCost: item.cost * between(0.85, 1.2),
    }));

  const suppliers = SUPPLIERS.map((supplier, index) => ({ ...supplier, id: id(PREFIX.supplier, index + 1), nextCode: 1 }));

  // El primer proveedor concentra muchas presentaciones (lista larga en su detalle).
  const presentations: Prisma.SupplierIngredientCreateManyInput[] = [];
  const unitCost = new Map<string, Prisma.Decimal>();
  const addPresentation = (supplierIndex: number, ingredient: (typeof ingredients)[number], isDefault: boolean) => {
    const supplier = suppliers[supplierIndex];
    const size = packageFor(ingredient.unit);
    const price = new Prisma.Decimal((ingredient.referenceCost * size * between(0.92, 1.1)).toFixed(2));
    if (isDefault) unitCost.set(ingredient.id, calculateUnitCost(price, new Prisma.Decimal(size)));
    presentations.push({
      id: id(PREFIX.presentation, presentations.length + 1),
      supplierId: supplier.id,
      ingredientId: ingredient.id,
      supplierCode: supplier.code + "-" + String(supplier.nextCode++).padStart(4, "0"),
      rawDescription: ingredient.name.toUpperCase() + " X " + size + (ingredient.unit === "u" ? " U" : " " + ingredient.unit.toUpperCase()),
      packageSize: new Prisma.Decimal(size.toFixed(3)),
      packageUnit: ingredient.unit,
      packagePrice: price,
      isDefault,
    });
  };

  ingredients.forEach((ingredient, index) => {
    const defaultSupplier = index < 60 ? 0 : 1 + (index % 4);
    addPresentation(defaultSupplier, ingredient, true);
    if (index < 8) {
      // Insumos con 5 proveedores: ficha con muchas presentaciones.
      for (let s = 0; s < suppliers.length; s++) if (s !== defaultSupplier) addPresentation(s, ingredient, false);
    } else if (index % 5 === 0) {
      addPresentation((defaultSupplier + 1) % suppliers.length, ingredient, false);
    }
  });

  // Tres presentaciones predeterminadas en cuarentena (+80 %).
  presentations
    .filter((item) => item.isDefault)
    .slice(10, 13)
    .forEach((item) => {
      item.isQuarantined = true;
      item.quarantinedAt = new Date();
      item.quarantineReason = "VARIACION_MAYOR_50_POR_CIENTO";
      item.pendingPackagePrice = new Prisma.Decimal(item.packagePrice as Prisma.Decimal).mul(1.8).toDecimalPlaces(2);
    });

  const ingredientByBase = new Map<string, typeof ingredients>();
  for (const ingredient of ingredients) {
    ingredientByBase.set(ingredient.base, [...(ingredientByBase.get(ingredient.base) ?? []), ingredient]);
  }

  const names = productNames()
    .filter((item) => !existingNames.has(item.name.toLowerCase()))
    .slice(0, productCount);

  const products: Prisma.ProductCreateManyInput[] = [];
  const lines: Prisma.ProductIngredientCreateManyInput[] = [];
  names.forEach(({ family, name }, index) => {
    const productId = id(PREFIX.product, index + 1);
    const minMarginPercent = new Prisma.Decimal(pick([25, 30, 35, 40]));
    const roll = random();

    // 5 % borradores sin receta y con precio 0.
    if (roll < 0.05) {
      products.push({ id: productId, accountId: ACCOUNT_ID, name, searchName: normalizeSearchText(name), salePrice: new Prisma.Decimal(0), minMarginPercent });
      return;
    }

    const candidates = family.uses.flatMap((base) => ingredientByBase.get(base) ?? []);
    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      products.push({ id: productId, accountId: ACCOUNT_ID, name, searchName: normalizeSearchText(name), salePrice: new Prisma.Decimal(0), minMarginPercent });
      return;
    }
    const chosen = new Map<string, (typeof ingredients)[number]>();
    const target = Math.min(candidates.length, 2 + Math.floor(random() * 5));
    while (chosen.size < target) {
      const ingredient = pick(candidates);
      chosen.set(ingredient.id, ingredient);
    }
    const recipe = [...chosen.values()].map((ingredient) => ({ ingredient, quantity: quantityFor(ingredient.unit) }));
    for (const item of recipe) lines.push({ productId, ingredientId: item.ingredient.id, quantity: item.quantity });

    const cost = calculateRecipeTotal(
      recipe.map((item) => ({ quantity: item.quantity, unitCost: unitCost.get(item.ingredient.id)! })),
    );

    // Distribución de márgenes: pérdida, riesgo, en objetivo y holgado.
    const min = minMarginPercent.toNumber() / 100;
    let margin: number;
    if (roll < 0.17) margin = between(-0.4, -0.02);
    else if (roll < 0.37) margin = between(0.02, min - 0.01);
    else if (roll < 0.77) margin = between(min, min + 0.15);
    else margin = between(min + 0.15, 0.75);
    let salePrice = cost.div(1 - margin).toDecimalPlaces(0);
    // Un precio mal cargado (sin ceros), caso real visto en las pruebas de usabilidad.
    if (index === 7) salePrice = new Prisma.Decimal(13);

    products.push({
      id: productId,
      accountId: ACCOUNT_ID,
      name,
      searchName: normalizeSearchText(name),
      salePrice,
      minMarginPercent,
      cost,
      marginAmount: calculateMarginAmount(salePrice, cost),
      marginPercent: calculateMarginPercent(salePrice, cost),
    });
  });

  // Historial: 12 cambios semanales en los primeros 20 insumos.
  const history: Prisma.PriceHistoryCreateManyInput[] = [];
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const ingredient of ingredients.slice(0, 20)) {
    let cost = ingredient.referenceCost * 0.7;
    for (let week = 12; week >= 1; week--) {
      const next = week === 1 ? unitCost.get(ingredient.id)!.toNumber() : cost * between(0.97, 1.08);
      history.push({
        id: id(PREFIX.history, history.length + 1),
        ingredientId: ingredient.id,
        oldCost: new Prisma.Decimal(cost.toFixed(2)),
        newCost: new Prisma.Decimal(next.toFixed(2)),
        changedAt: new Date(now - week * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
      });
      cost = next;
    }
  }

  return {
    ingredients: ingredients.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      accountId: ACCOUNT_ID,
      name: item.name,
      searchName: normalizeSearchText(item.name),
      unit: item.unit,
      currentCost: unitCost.get(item.id)!,
    })),
    suppliers: suppliers.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      accountId: ACCOUNT_ID,
      name: item.name,
      contactPhone: item.phone,
      email: item.email,
      address: item.address,
    })),
    presentations,
    products,
    lines,
    history,
  };
}

async function timed<T>(label: string, timings: Array<{ paso: string; ms: number }>, run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const start = performance.now();
  const result = await run();
  timings.push({ paso: label, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - start) });
  return result;
}

// Chequeos de integridad sobre toda la cuenta Demo (base + volumen).
async function integrityReport() {
  const [costMismatch, defaults, buckets, orphanDrafts] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ total: bigint }>>`
      SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS total FROM (
        SELECT p.id, p.cost, ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pi.quantity * i."currentCost", 2)), 2) AS expected
        FROM "Product" p
        JOIN "ProductIngredient" pi ON pi."productId" = p.id
        JOIN "Ingredient" i ON i.id = pi."ingredientId"
        WHERE p."accountId" = ${ACCOUNT_ID}
        GROUP BY p.id, p.cost
      ) t WHERE t.cost <> t.expected`,
    prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ sin_predeterminado: bigint; con_varios: bigint }>>`
      SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE defaults = 0)::bigint AS sin_predeterminado,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE defaults > 1)::bigint AS con_varios
      FROM (
        SELECT i.id, COUNT(si.id) FILTER (WHERE si."isDefault") AS defaults
        FROM "Ingredient" i
        JOIN "SupplierIngredient" si ON si."ingredientId" = i.id
        WHERE i."accountId" = ${ACCOUNT_ID}
        GROUP BY i.id
      ) t`,
    prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ estado: string; total: bigint }>>`
      SELECT CASE
          WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ProductIngredient" pi WHERE pi."productId" = p.id) THEN 'borrador'
          WHEN p."marginPercent" < 0 THEN 'pérdida'
          WHEN p."marginPercent" < p."minMarginPercent" THEN 'en riesgo'
          ELSE 'en objetivo o más'
        END AS estado, COUNT(*)::bigint AS total
      FROM "Product" p WHERE p."accountId" = ${ACCOUNT_ID}
      GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1`,
    prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ total: bigint }>>`
      SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS total FROM "Product" p
      WHERE p."accountId" = ${ACCOUNT_ID} AND p."salePrice" = 0
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ProductIngredient" pi WHERE pi."productId" = p.id)`,
  ]);

  console.log("\nIntegridad de la cuenta Demo (0 es lo esperado en las tres primeras filas):");
  console.table([
    { chequeo: "Productos cuyo costo guardado no coincide con su receta", total: Number(costMismatch[0].total) },
    { chequeo: "Insumos con presentaciones pero sin predeterminada", total: Number(defaults[0].sin_predeterminado) },
    { chequeo: "Insumos con más de una predeterminada", total: Number(defaults[0].con_varios) },
    { chequeo: "Productos con receta y precio 0", total: Number(orphanDrafts[0].total) },
  ]);
  console.log("Productos por estado de margen:");
  console.table(buckets.map((row) => ({ estado: row.estado, total: Number(row.total) })));
}

async function main() {
  confirmDatabaseTarget();
  const mode = process.env.SEED_VOLUMEN_MODO ?? "cargar";
  if (mode !== "cargar" && mode !== "limpiar") throw new Error('SEED_VOLUMEN_MODO debe ser "cargar" o "limpiar".');

  const account = await prisma.account.findUnique({ where: { id: ACCOUNT_ID } });
  if (!account) throw new Error("No existe la cuenta Demo. Corré primero seed-demo.ts.");

  const timings: Array<{ paso: string; ms: number }> = [];

  if (mode === "limpiar") {
    const removed = await timed("limpiar", timings, () => prisma.$transaction((tx) => clean(tx), { timeout: 120000 }));
    console.log("Volumen eliminado de la cuenta Demo:");
    console.table([removed]);
    console.table(timings);
    return;
  }

  const [baseIngredients, baseProducts] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.ingredient.findMany({ where: { accountId: ACCOUNT_ID, NOT: { id: { startsWith: "32b" } } }, select: { name: true } }),
    prisma.product.findMany({ where: { accountId: ACCOUNT_ID, NOT: { id: { startsWith: "32f" } } }, select: { name: true } }),
  ]);
  const existingNames = new Set([...baseIngredients, ...baseProducts].map((row) => row.name.toLowerCase()));
  const data = buildData(
    positiveInt("SEED_VOLUMEN_INSUMOS", 210, BASES.length * BRANDS.length),
    positiveInt("SEED_VOLUMEN_PRODUCTOS", 336, MAX_PRODUCTS),
    existingNames,
  );

  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await timed("limpiar carga anterior", timings, () => clean(tx));
    await timed("insumos", timings, () => tx.ingredient.createMany({ data: data.ingredients }));
    await timed("proveedores", timings, () => tx.supplier.createMany({ data: data.suppliers }));
    await timed("presentaciones", timings, () => tx.supplierIngredient.createMany({ data: data.presentations }));
    await timed("productos", timings, () => tx.product.createMany({ data: data.products }));
    await timed("líneas de receta", timings, () => tx.productIngredient.createMany({ data: data.lines }));
    await timed("historial de precios", timings, () => tx.priceHistory.createMany({ data: data.history }));
  }, { timeout: 120000 });

  console.log("Volumen cargado en la cuenta " + account.businessName + ":");
  console.table([
    { tabla: "Insumos", total: data.ingredients.length },
    { tabla: "Proveedores", total: data.suppliers.length },
    { tabla: "Presentaciones", total: data.presentations.length },
    { tabla: "Presentaciones en cuarentena", total: data.presentations.filter((item) => item.isQuarantined).length },
    { tabla: "Productos", total: data.products.length },
    { tabla: "Líneas de receta", total: data.lines.length },
    { tabla: "Cambios en el historial", total: data.history.length },
  ]);
  console.log("Tiempos de escritura (ms):");
  console.table(timings);

  await integrityReport();
}

main()
  .catch((error: unknown) => {
    console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Error inesperado al ejecutar el seed de volumen.");
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });
</file>

<file path="backend/src/middlewares/auth.test.ts">
// src/middlewares/auth.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { Response, NextFunction } from 'express';

const verifyTokenMock = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@clerk/backend', () => ({
  verifyToken: (...args: unknown[]) => verifyTokenMock(...args),
}));

const findUniqueMock = vi.fn();
vi.mock('../lib/prisma', () => ({
  prisma: { user: { findUnique: (...args: unknown[]) => findUniqueMock(...args) } },
}));

const provisionInvitedUserMock = vi.fn();
vi.mock('../services/invitedUserProvisioning', async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('../services/invitedUserProvisioning')>();
  return {
    AUTH_USER_SELECT: actual.AUTH_USER_SELECT,
    provisionInvitedUser: (...args: unknown[]) => provisionInvitedUserMock(...args),
  };
});

import { authMiddleware, AuthenticatedRequest } from './auth';

function buildReqRes(authHeader?: string) {
  const req = { headers: { authorization: authHeader } } as unknown as AuthenticatedRequest;
  const json = vi.fn();
  const status = vi.fn(() => ({ json }));
  const res = { status } as unknown as Response;
  const next = vi.fn() as NextFunction;
  return { req, res, next, status, json };
}

describe('authMiddleware', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    verifyTokenMock.mockReset();
    findUniqueMock.mockReset();
    provisionInvitedUserMock.mockReset();
    provisionInvitedUserMock.mockResolvedValue(null);
  });

  it('devuelve 401 si no hay header Authorization', async () => {
    const { req, res, next, status, json } = buildReqRes(undefined);
    await authMiddleware(req, res, next);
    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(401);
    expect(json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: 'No autorizado' });
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('devuelve 401 si el header no tiene formato "Bearer <token>"', async () => {
    const { req, res, next, status } = buildReqRes('Token abc123');
    await authMiddleware(req, res, next);
    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(401);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('devuelve 401 si verifyToken lanza (token inválido/expirado)', async () => {
    verifyTokenMock.mockRejectedValue(new Error('invalid token'));
    const { req, res, next, status } = buildReqRes('Bearer bad-token');
    await authMiddleware(req, res, next);
    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(401);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('devuelve 401 si el token es válido, no existe el usuario y no trae una invitación válida', async () => {
    verifyTokenMock.mockResolvedValue({ sub: 'clerk-user-1' });
    findUniqueMock.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const { req, res, next, status, json } = buildReqRes('Bearer good-token');
    await authMiddleware(req, res, next);
    expect(findUniqueMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      where: { authProviderId: 'clerk-user-1' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        accountId: true,
        email: true,
        role: true,
        account: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            businessName: true,
            defaultMinMarginPercent: true,
            slug: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(401);
    expect(json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: 'No autorizado' });
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('setea req.user y llama next() si el token y el usuario son válidos', async () => {
    verifyTokenMock.mockResolvedValue({ sub: 'clerk-user-1' });
    const user = {
      id: 'u1',
      accountId: 'a1',
      email: 'x@x.com',
      role: 'ADMIN',
      account: {
        id: 'a1',
        businessName: 'Panadería Central',
        defaultMinMarginPercent: { toString: () => '15.5' },
      },
    };
    findUniqueMock.mockResolvedValue(user);
    const { req, res, next } = buildReqRes('Bearer good-token');
    await authMiddleware(req, res, next);
    expect(req.user).toEqual(user);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('primer inicio de sesión de un invitado: crea el User y llama next()', async () => {
    verifyTokenMock.mockResolvedValue({ sub: 'user_repositor_quimica' });
    findUniqueMock.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const invited = {
      id: 'u-repositor',
      accountId: 'acc-quimica',
      email: 'colab.quimica@seed.example.test',
      role: 'COLLABORATOR',
      account: { id: 'acc-quimica', businessName: 'Química GyJ', defaultMinMarginPercent: '35.00', slug: 'quimica-gyj' },
    };
    provisionInvitedUserMock.mockResolvedValue(invited);
    const { req, res, next, status } = buildReqRes('Bearer good-token');

    await authMiddleware(req, res, next);

    expect(provisionInvitedUserMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user_repositor_quimica');
    expect(req.user).toEqual(invited);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(status).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('no busca invitación si el usuario ya existe', async () => {
    verifyTokenMock.mockResolvedValue({ sub: 'clerk-user-1' });
    findUniqueMock.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'u1', accountId: 'a1', email: 'x@x.com', role: 'ADMIN' });
    const { req, res, next } = buildReqRes('Bearer good-token');

    await authMiddleware(req, res, next);

    expect(provisionInvitedUserMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('devuelve 401 si el alta del invitado falla', async () => {
    verifyTokenMock.mockResolvedValue({ sub: 'user_x' });
    findUniqueMock.mockResolvedValue(null);
    provisionInvitedUserMock.mockRejectedValue(new Error('base caída'));
    const { req, res, next, status } = buildReqRes('Bearer good-token');

    await authMiddleware(req, res, next);

    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(401);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
</file>

<file path="backend/src/middlewares/auth.ts">
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { verifyToken } from '@clerk/backend';
import { prisma } from '../lib/prisma';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { AUTH_USER_SELECT, provisionInvitedUser } from '../services/invitedUserProvisioning';

export interface AuthenticatedRequest extends Request {
  user?: {
    id: string;
    accountId: string;
    email: string;
    role: 'ADMIN' | 'COLLABORATOR';
    account?: {
      id: string;
      businessName: string;
      defaultMinMarginPercent: Prisma.Decimal;
      slug: string;
    };
  };
}

export async function authMiddleware(
  req: AuthenticatedRequest,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction
) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;

  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'No autorizado' });
  }

  const token = authHeader.slice(7);

  try {
    const payload = await verifyToken(token, {
      secretKey: process.env.CLERK_SECRET_KEY!,
      jwtKey: process.env.CLERK_JWT_KEY,
    });

    // Sin fila en User: puede ser el primer inicio de sesión de un invitado (ADR-008).
    // La cuenta y el rol salen de los metadatos que escribió el backend, nunca del cliente.
    const user =
      (await prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { authProviderId: payload.sub },
        select: AUTH_USER_SELECT,
      })) ?? (await provisionInvitedUser(payload.sub));

    if (!user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'No autorizado' });
    }

    req.user = user;
    next();
  } catch {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'No autorizado' });
  }
}
</file>

<file path="backend/src/middlewares/rbac.ts">
import { AppError } from './errorHandler';
import type { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import type { NextFunction, Response } from 'express';
import type { AuthenticatedRequest } from './auth';

export const FINANCIAL_FIELDS = new Set([
  'cost',
  'marginAmount',
  'marginPercent',
  'minMarginPercent',
  'defaultMinMarginPercent',
  'marginStatus',
  'currentCost',
  'oldCost',
  'newCost',
  'packagePrice',
  'packageSize',
  'quantity',
  'unitCost',
  'suppliers',
]);

const SAFE_METHODS = new Set(['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']);

function stripFinancialFields(body: unknown): unknown {
  if (body === undefined) {
    return body;
  }

  return JSON.parse(
    JSON.stringify(body, (key, value) => (FINANCIAL_FIELDS.has(key) ? undefined : value))
  );
}

function formatRequiredRoles(allowedRoles: Role[]): string {
  if (allowedRoles.length === 0) {
    return 'un rol válido';
  }

  if (allowedRoles.length === 1) {
    return allowedRoles[0]!;
  }

  return `${allowedRoles.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} o ${allowedRoles[allowedRoles.length - 1]}`;
}

export function requireRole(allowedRoles: Role[]) {
  return (req: AuthenticatedRequest, _res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    if (!req.user) {
      return next(new AppError('No autorizado', 401));
    }

    if (!allowedRoles.includes(req.user.role)) {
      return next(new AppError(`Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ${formatRequiredRoles(allowedRoles)}.`, 403));
    }

    return next();
  };
}

export function blockCollaboratorMutations(req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
  if (!req.user) {
    return next(new AppError('No autorizado', 401));
  }

  if (req.user.role === 'ADMIN' || SAFE_METHODS.has(req.method)) {
    return next();
  }

  return requireRole(['ADMIN'])(req, res, next);
}

export function sanitizeFinancialData(req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
  if (!req.user || req.user.role !== 'COLLABORATOR') {
    return next();
  }

  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');

  const originalJson = res.json.bind(res);
  res.json = ((body: unknown) => originalJson(stripFinancialFields(body))) as typeof res.json;

  return next();
}
</file>

<file path="backend/src/routes/dashboard.ts">
import { Router, Response } from 'express';
import { prisma } from '../lib/prisma';
import { authMiddleware, AuthenticatedRequest } from '../middlewares/auth';
import { requireRole } from '../middlewares/rbac';
import { calculateCatalogHealthSummary } from '../services/marginCalculator';

const router = Router();

router.use(authMiddleware);

router.get('/metrics', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;

  const sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
  sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);

  const [activeIngredientsCount, productRows, recentCostVariations] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.ingredient.count({ where: { accountId } }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { accountId },
      select: {
        marginPercent: true,
        minMarginPercent: true,
        _count: { select: { ingredients: true } },
      },
    }),
    prisma.priceHistory.groupBy({
      by: ['ingredientId'],
      where: {
        ingredient: { accountId },
        changedAt: { gte: sevenDaysAgo },
      },
    }),
  ]);

  const summary = calculateCatalogHealthSummary(
    productRows.map((product) => ({
      marginPercent: product.marginPercent,
      minMarginPercent: product.minMarginPercent,
      ingredientsCount: product._count?.ingredients ?? 0,
    }))
  );

  const recentCostVariationsCount = new Set(
    recentCostVariations.map((entry) => entry.ingredientId)
  ).size;

  const response = {
    activeIngredientsCount,
    criticalProductsCount: summary.criticalProductsCount,
    healthyProductsCount: summary.healthyProductsCount,
    averageMarginPercent: summary.averageMarginPercent,
    recentCostVariationsCount,
    lossCount: summary.lossCount,
    riskCount: summary.riskCount,
    targetCount: summary.targetCount,
    surplusCount: summary.surplusCount,
    draftCount: summary.draftCount,
  };

  return res.status(200).json(response);
});

export default router;
</file>

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import express from 'express';
import request from 'supertest';
import type { NextFunction, Response } from 'express';
import type { AuthenticatedRequest } from '../middlewares/auth';
import { errorHandler } from '../middlewares/errorHandler';

const authState = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  authenticated: true,
  role: 'ADMIN' as 'ADMIN' | 'COLLABORATOR',
  accountId: 'acc-panaderia',
}));

vi.mock('../middlewares/auth', () => ({
  authMiddleware: (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    if (!authState.authenticated) {
      res.status(401).json({ error: 'No autorizado' });
      return;
    }
    req.user = {
      id: 'user-1',
      accountId: authState.accountId,
      email: 'admin.panaderia@seed.example.test',
      role: authState.role,
    };
    next();
  },
}));

const buildWeeklyMarginReportMock = vi.fn();
vi.mock('../services/reportService', async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('../services/reportService')>();
  return {
    ...actual,
    buildWeeklyMarginReport: (...args: unknown[]) => buildWeeklyMarginReportMock(...args),
  };
});

import reportsRouter from './reports';

function buildApp() {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/reports', reportsRouter);
  app.use(errorHandler);
  return app;
}

const SAMPLE_REPORT = {
  account: {
    id: 'acc-panaderia',
    businessName: 'Panadería Central',
    slug: 'panaderia-central',
    defaultMinMarginPercent: '30.00',
  },
  period: {
    from: '2026-11-10T03:00:00.000Z',
    to: '2026-11-17T03:00:00.000Z',
    timezone: 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires',
    fromFormatted: '10/11/2026',
    toFormatted: '17/11/2026',
  },
  generatedAt: '2026-11-17T15:00:00.000Z',
  catalogHealth: {
    totalProducts: 10,
    activeIngredientsCount: 10,
    criticalProductsCount: 1,
    healthyProductsCount: 9,
    averageMarginPercent: 60.5,
    lossCount: 0,
    riskCount: 1,
    targetCount: 4,
    surplusCount: 5,
    draftCount: 0,
  },
  belowMinimumProducts: { totalCount: 1, items: [] },
  weeklyCostChanges: { totalCount: 0, items: [] },
  quarantine: { totalCount: 0, items: [] },
  purchasingSavings: { totalCount: 0, items: [] },
  staleCosts: { totalCount: 0, thresholdDays: 30, items: [] },
};

describe('rutas de reportes para la app', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    authState.authenticated = true;
    authState.role = 'ADMIN';
    authState.accountId = 'acc-panaderia';
    process.env.N8N_REPORT_PDF_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://n8n.example.test/webhook/report-pdf';
    process.env.INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET = 'secreto-pdf-test';
    buildWeeklyMarginReportMock.mockReset();
    buildWeeklyMarginReportMock.mockResolvedValue(SAMPLE_REPORT);
    vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    delete process.env.N8N_REPORT_PDF_WEBHOOK_URL;
    delete process.env.INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it('requiere autenticación y rol ADMIN para JSON y PDF', async () => {
    authState.authenticated = false;
    const unauthenticatedApp = buildApp();
    expect((await request(unauthenticatedApp).get('/api/reports/weekly')).status).toBe(401);
    expect((await request(unauthenticatedApp).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf')).status).toBe(401);

    authState.authenticated = true;
    authState.role = 'COLLABORATOR';
    const collaboratorApp = buildApp();
    const jsonResponse = await request(collaboratorApp).get('/api/reports/weekly');
    const pdfResponse = await request(collaboratorApp).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf');
    expect(jsonResponse.status).toBe(403);
    expect(jsonResponse.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');
    expect(pdfResponse.status).toBe(403);
    expect(buildWeeklyMarginReportMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('devuelve el reporte JSON de la cuenta del usuario autenticado', async () => {
    const response = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly');

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(response.body).toEqual(SAMPLE_REPORT);
    expect(buildWeeklyMarginReportMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith('acc-panaderia', {
      from: undefined,
      to: undefined,
    });
  });

  it('devuelve PDF con encabezados de descarga y timeout de 20 segundos', async () => {
    const pdf = Buffer.from('%PDF-1.4\n%MargenX Panaderia Central\n%%EOF');
    const timeoutSpy = vi.spyOn(AbortSignal, 'timeout');
    const fetchMock = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      ok: true,
      status: 200,
      arrayBuffer: async () =>
        pdf.buffer.slice(pdf.byteOffset, pdf.byteOffset + pdf.byteLength),
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);

    const response = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf');

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(response.headers['content-type']).toMatch(/application\/pdf/);
    expect(response.headers['content-disposition']).toBe(
      'attachment; filename="margenx-reporte-2026-11-17.pdf"'
    );
    expect(response.headers['cache-control']).toBe('private, no-store');
    // La app y la API están en orígenes distintos: sin esta cabecera el navegador oculta el nombre del archivo.
    expect(response.headers['access-control-expose-headers']).toBe('Content-Disposition');
    expect(Buffer.from(response.body).toString('utf8')).toContain('%PDF-1.4');
    const [url, init] = fetchMock.mock.calls[0] as [string, RequestInit];
    expect(url).toBe('https://n8n.example.test/webhook/report-pdf');
    expect(init).toMatchObject({
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'x-margenx-webhook-secret': 'secreto-pdf-test',
      },
    });
    expect(JSON.parse(init.body as string)).toEqual(SAMPLE_REPORT);
    expect(init.signal).toBeInstanceOf(AbortSignal);
    expect(timeoutSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(20_000);
  });

  it('traduce fallos de red, respuestas de error y contenido vacío en 503 genérico', async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal(
      'fetch',
      vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new DOMException('The operation timed out', 'TimeoutError'))
    );
    const timeoutResponse = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf');
    expect(timeoutResponse.status).toBe(503);
    expect(timeoutResponse.body.error).toBe(
      'No pudimos generar el reporte PDF en este momento. Probá de nuevo en unos minutos.'
    );
    expect(JSON.stringify(timeoutResponse.body)).not.toMatch(
      /TimeoutError|n8n\.example|secreto|ENOTFOUND/i
    );

    vi.stubGlobal(
      'fetch',
      vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ok: false, status: 500, statusText: 'Internal Server Error' })
    );
    const serverErrorResponse = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf');
    expect(serverErrorResponse.status).toBe(503);
    expect(serverErrorResponse.body.error).not.toMatch(/500|n8n|Internal Server Error/i);

    vi.stubGlobal(
      'fetch',
      vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        arrayBuffer: async () => new ArrayBuffer(0),
      })
    );
    expect((await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf')).status).toBe(503);
  });

  it('rechaza con 503 genérico si n8n responde 200 con JSON, HTML o contenido sin firma PDF', async () => {
    const jsonPayload = Buffer.from('{"message":"Workflow was started"}');
    vi.stubGlobal(
      'fetch',
      vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        headers: new Headers({ 'content-type': 'application/json' }),
        arrayBuffer: async () =>
          jsonPayload.buffer.slice(
            jsonPayload.byteOffset,
            jsonPayload.byteOffset + jsonPayload.byteLength
          ),
      })
    );
    const jsonResponse = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf');
    expect(jsonResponse.status).toBe(503);
    expect(jsonResponse.body.error).toBe(
      'No pudimos generar el reporte PDF en este momento. Probá de nuevo en unos minutos.'
    );
    expect(JSON.stringify(jsonResponse.body)).not.toMatch(/Workflow|json|n8n/i);

    const htmlPayload = Buffer.from('<html>Error de proxy</html>');
    vi.stubGlobal(
      'fetch',
      vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        headers: new Headers({ 'content-type': 'application/pdf' }),
        arrayBuffer: async () =>
          htmlPayload.buffer.slice(
            htmlPayload.byteOffset,
            htmlPayload.byteOffset + htmlPayload.byteLength
          ),
      })
    );
    const htmlResponse = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf');
    expect(htmlResponse.status).toBe(503);
    expect(htmlResponse.body.error).toBe(
      'No pudimos generar el reporte PDF en este momento. Probá de nuevo en unos minutos.'
    );
  });

  it('falla en modo cerrado y no llama a n8n si falta URL o secreto', async () => {
    delete process.env.N8N_REPORT_PDF_WEBHOOK_URL;
    const fetchMock = vi.fn();
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);

    const noUrl = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf');
    expect(noUrl.status).toBe(503);
    expect(noUrl.body.error).not.toMatch(/N8N_REPORT_PDF_WEBHOOK_URL/);
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    process.env.N8N_REPORT_PDF_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://n8n.example.test/webhook/report-pdf';
    delete process.env.INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
    const noSecret = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/reports/weekly.pdf');
    expect(noSecret.status).toBe(503);
    expect(noSecret.body.error).not.toMatch(/INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET/);
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

<file path="backend/src/routes/reports.ts">
import { Router, type Response } from 'express';
import { authMiddleware, type AuthenticatedRequest } from '../middlewares/auth';
import { AppError } from '../middlewares/errorHandler';
import { requireRole } from '../middlewares/rbac';
import { buildWeeklyMarginReport, formatArgentinaIsoDate } from '../services/reportService';
import { parseReportRangeQuery } from './internalReports';

const router = Router();

const PDF_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000;
const PDF_SIGNATURE = '%PDF-';
const PDF_UNAVAILABLE_MSG =
  'No pudimos generar el reporte PDF en este momento. Probá de nuevo en unos minutos.';

router.use(authMiddleware);
router.use(requireRole(['ADMIN']));

router.get('/weekly', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const range = parseReportRangeQuery(req.query as Record<string, unknown>);
  const report = await buildWeeklyMarginReport(req.user!.accountId, range);
  return res.status(200).json(report);
});

router.get('/weekly.pdf', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const webhookUrl = process.env.N8N_REPORT_PDF_WEBHOOK_URL?.trim();
  const webhookSecret = process.env.INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET?.trim();

  if (!webhookUrl || !webhookSecret) {
    console.error(
      '[WeeklyReportPDF] Falta N8N_REPORT_PDF_WEBHOOK_URL o INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET: generación PDF deshabilitada.'
    );
    throw new AppError(PDF_UNAVAILABLE_MSG, 503);
  }

  const range = parseReportRangeQuery(req.query as Record<string, unknown>);
  const report = await buildWeeklyMarginReport(req.user!.accountId, range);

  let pdfBuffer: Buffer;
  let responseContentType = '';
  try {
    const response = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'User-Agent': 'MargenX-Backend-Dispatcher/1.0',
        'x-margenx-webhook-secret': webhookSecret,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(report),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(PDF_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      console.error(
        `[WeeklyReportPDF] n8n respondió HTTP ${response.status} al generar el PDF de la cuenta ${req.user!.accountId}.`
      );
      throw new AppError(PDF_UNAVAILABLE_MSG, 503);
    }

    responseContentType = response.headers?.get('content-type')?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
    pdfBuffer = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AppError) {
      throw error;
    }
    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'desconocido';
    console.error(`[WeeklyReportPDF] Error al contactar a n8n (${reason}).`);
    throw new AppError(PDF_UNAVAILABLE_MSG, 503);
  }

  const hasUnexpectedContentType =
    responseContentType !== '' &&
    !responseContentType.includes('application/pdf') &&
    !responseContentType.includes('application/octet-stream');
  const hasPdfSignature =
    pdfBuffer.subarray(0, PDF_SIGNATURE.length).toString('ascii') === PDF_SIGNATURE;

  if (pdfBuffer.length === 0 || hasUnexpectedContentType || !hasPdfSignature) {
    console.error(
      `[WeeklyReportPDF] n8n devolvió una respuesta inválida (bytes=${pdfBuffer.length}, contentType="${responseContentType || 'ausente'}").`
    );
    throw new AppError(PDF_UNAVAILABLE_MSG, 503);
  }

  const dateTag = formatArgentinaIsoDate(new Date(report.generatedAt));
  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/pdf');
  res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="margenx-reporte-${dateTag}.pdf"`);
  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
  // La app y la API se publican en orígenes distintos: sin exponerla, el navegador no deja leer el nombre.
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Expose-Headers', 'Content-Disposition');

  return res.status(200).send(pdfBuffer);
});

export default router;
</file>

<file path="backend/src/routes/webhooks.ts">
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';

import { prisma } from '../lib/prisma';
import { AppError } from '../middlewares/errorHandler';
import {
  applyBatchIngredientCostChanges,
  calculateUnitCost,
  type CriticalMarginProduct,
} from '../services/marginCalculator';

const router = Router();

/**
 * POST /api/webhooks/supplier-prices
 * Webhook de ingesta por proveedor.
 *
 * Contrato de integración con n8n / sistema satélite que reenvía listas de precios
 * recibidas por correo o WhatsApp. El backend valida el secreto compartido, resuelve
 * cada `supplierCode` dentro de la cuenta y del proveedor correcto, descarta filas sin
 * mapeo y conserva un resumen fiable de qué se actualizó, quedó sin cambios, pasó a
 * cuarentena o fue descartado.
 *
 * El diseño está alineado con la documentación del proyecto en /docs:
 * - la identificación del proveedor es implícita por `supplierCode`
 * - las listas no crean nuevos insumos ni contaminan el catálogo
 * - los cambios de costo solo se ejecutan si el valor es real y válido
 * - n8n conserva la lógica de ensamblado del resumen final y de las alertas
 *
 * Payload esperado:
 * {
 *   accountSlug: string,
 *   items: [{ code: string, description?: string, price: number }]
 * }
 * 
 * 200 OK | 400 Payload inválido | 401 No autorizado | 404 Slug inexistente/inactivo
 */
export const supplierPricesIngestSchema = z.object({
  accountSlug: z.string().trim().min(2),
  items: z.array(
    z.object({
      code: z.string().trim().min(1),
      description: z.string().optional(),
      price: z.coerce.number().positive(),
    })
  ).min(1).max(5000),
});

/**
 * Valida la cabecera `x-margenx-webhook-secret` del servicio satélite.
 *
 * Se usa `timingSafeEqual` para evitar ataques de timing en la autenticación
 * inter-servicio. El patrón es fail-closed: si falta o es incorrecto, el webhook
 * responde 401 y no procesa ninguna solicitud.
 */
function hasValidInternalSecret(req: Request): boolean {
  const expectedSecret = process.env.INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '';
  const incomingSecret = req.get('x-margenx-webhook-secret') ?? '';

  if (!expectedSecret || !incomingSecret) {
    return false;
  }

  const expected = Buffer.from(expectedSecret);
  const actual = Buffer.from(incomingSecret);

  if (expected.length !== actual.length) {
    return false;
  }

  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(expected, actual);
}

/**
 * Procesa la ingesta masiva de precios de un proveedor.
 *
 * Flujo de negocio:
 * 1. valida autenticación interna
 * 2. valida el payload
 * 3. resuelve la cuenta activa por `accountSlug`
 * 4. deduplica items por `code` dentro del mismo lote
 * 5. busca coincidencias de `supplierCode` dentro de la cuenta
 * 6. descarta filas sin mapping, proveedor inactivo o ambiguas
 * 7. compara el precio contra la presentación vigente para decidir:
 *    - mismo precio => `unchanged`
 *    - precio anómalo => `quarantined`
 *    - precio válido => `updated`
 * 8. si aplica, recalcula `Ingredient.currentCost` y dispara la cascada de productos
 * 9. responde un resumen veraz para que n8n construya el correo y el dashboard
 *
 * La lógica respeta la arquitectura definida en /docs:
 * - no crea nuevos insumos
 * - no mezcla proveedores distintos dentro de la misma cuenta
 * - no recalcula si no hubo cambio
 * - no sobreescribe precios en cuarentena
 */
router.post('/supplier-prices', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (!hasValidInternalSecret(req)) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  }

  const parsed = supplierPricesIngestSchema.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const issue = parsed.error.issues[0];
    return res.status(400).json({
      error: issue?.message ?? 'Payload inválido.',
    });
  }

  const { accountSlug, items } = parsed.data;

  const account = await prisma.account.findUnique({
    where: { slug: accountSlug },
    include: {
      users: {
        where: { role: 'ADMIN' },
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
        take: 1,
        select: { email: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!account || !account.isActive) {
    throw new AppError('No existe una cuenta activa para el slug indicado.', 404);
  }

  const dedupedItems = new Map<string, (typeof items)[number]>();
  let duplicates = 0;

  for (const item of items) {
    if (dedupedItems.has(item.code)) {
      duplicates += 1;
    }
    dedupedItems.set(item.code, item);
  }

  const uniqueItems = [...dedupedItems.values()];
  const incomingCodes = uniqueItems.map((item) => item.code);
  const mappedRows = await prisma.supplierIngredient.findMany({
    where: {
      supplierCode: { in: incomingCodes, mode: 'insensitive' },
      ingredient: { accountId: account.id },
    },
    include: {
      ingredient: true,
      supplier: true,
    },
  });

  const mappedByCode = new Map<string, typeof mappedRows>();
  for (const row of mappedRows) {
    const key = row.supplierCode?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (!key) continue;
    const bucket = mappedByCode.get(key) ?? [];
    bucket.push(row);
    mappedByCode.set(key, bucket);
  }

  const discardedCodes: Array<{ code: string; reason: string }> = [];
  const criticalProductsAlerts: Array<{
    productId?: string;
    productName?: string;
    previousCost?: string;
    newCost?: string;
    currentMarginPercent?: string;
    minMarginPercent?: string;
  }> = [];

  let updated = 0;
  let unchanged = 0;
  let quarantined = 0;
  let discarded = 0;

  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx: any) => {
    const defaultIngredientChanges: Array<{
      ingredientId: string;
      previousCost: Prisma.Decimal;
      newCost: Prisma.Decimal;
    }> = [];

    for (const item of uniqueItems) {
      const lookupKey = item.code.trim().toLowerCase();
      const rows = mappedByCode.get(lookupKey) ?? [];
      const activeRows = rows.filter((row) => row.supplier?.isActive !== false);

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        discarded += 1;
        discardedCodes.push({ code: item.code, reason: 'NOT_FOUND' });
        continue;
      }

      if (activeRows.length === 0) {
        discarded += 1;
        discardedCodes.push({ code: item.code, reason: 'INACTIVE_SUPPLIER' });
        continue;
      }

      if (new Set(activeRows.map((row) => row.supplierId)).size > 1) {
        discarded += 1;
        discardedCodes.push({ code: item.code, reason: 'AMBIGUOUS' });
        continue;
      }

      const mapped = activeRows[0];
      if (!mapped) {
        discarded += 1;
        discardedCodes.push({ code: item.code, reason: 'AMBIGUOUS' });
        continue;
      }

      const newPrice = new Prisma.Decimal(String(item.price));
      const previousPackagePrice = mapped.packagePrice;
      let previousUnitCost: Prisma.Decimal;
      let newUnitCost: Prisma.Decimal | null = null;
      let shouldQuarantine = false;
      let quarantineReason = 'VARIACION_MAYOR_50_POR_CIENTO';

      try {
        previousUnitCost = calculateUnitCost(previousPackagePrice, mapped.packageSize);
      } catch (_error) {
        previousUnitCost = new Prisma.Decimal('0');
      }

      try {
        newUnitCost = calculateUnitCost(newPrice, mapped.packageSize);
      } catch (_error) {
        shouldQuarantine = true;
        quarantineReason = 'COSTO_UNITARIO_INSUFICIENTE';
      }

      const zero = new Prisma.Decimal('0');
      const threshold = new Prisma.Decimal('50');
      const variation = previousUnitCost.gt(zero) && newUnitCost
        ? newUnitCost.sub(previousUnitCost).div(previousUnitCost).mul(100).abs()
        : new Prisma.Decimal('1000');

      const isSamePrice = newPrice.equals(previousPackagePrice);
      if (isSamePrice) {
        if (mapped.isQuarantined) {
          await tx.supplierIngredient.update({
            where: { id: mapped.id },
            data: {
              pendingPackagePrice: null,
              isQuarantined: false,
              quarantinedAt: null,
              quarantineReason: null,
            },
          });
        }
        unchanged += 1;
        continue;
      }

      if (!shouldQuarantine && newUnitCost) {
        shouldQuarantine = newUnitCost.lte(new Prisma.Decimal('0.01')) || variation.gt(threshold);
      }
      if (shouldQuarantine && quarantineReason === 'VARIACION_MAYOR_50_POR_CIENTO' && newUnitCost?.lte(new Prisma.Decimal('0.01'))) {
        quarantineReason = 'COSTO_UNITARIO_INSUFICIENTE';
      }

      await tx.supplierIngredient.update({
        where: { id: mapped.id },
        data: shouldQuarantine
          ? {
            packagePrice: previousPackagePrice,
            pendingPackagePrice: newPrice,
            isQuarantined: true,
            quarantinedAt: new Date(),
            quarantineReason,
          }
          : {
            packagePrice: newPrice,
            pendingPackagePrice: null,
            isQuarantined: false,
            quarantinedAt: null,
            quarantineReason: null,
          },
      });

      if (shouldQuarantine) {
        quarantined += 1;
        continue;
      }

      if (mapped.isDefault) {
        const ingredientSnapshot = await tx.ingredient.findUnique({
          where: { id: mapped.ingredientId },
          select: { currentCost: true },
        });
        const previousCost = ingredientSnapshot?.currentCost ?? mapped.ingredient.currentCost;

        if (!newUnitCost) {
          quarantined += 1;
          continue;
        }

        await tx.ingredient.update({
          where: { id: mapped.ingredientId },
          data: { currentCost: newUnitCost },
        });

        defaultIngredientChanges.push({
          ingredientId: mapped.ingredientId,
          previousCost,
          newCost: newUnitCost,
        });
      }

      updated += 1;
    }

    // Recálculo masivo en lote para todos los insumos por defecto actualizados
    if (defaultIngredientChanges.length > 0) {
      const { criticalProducts } = await applyBatchIngredientCostChanges(
        tx,
        defaultIngredientChanges
      );

      criticalProductsAlerts.push(
        ...criticalProducts.map((product: CriticalMarginProduct) => ({
          productId: product.productId,
          productName: product.productName,
          previousCost: product.previousCost.toFixed(2),
          newCost: product.newCost.toFixed(2),
          currentMarginPercent: product.currentMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
          minMarginPercent: product.minMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
        }))
      );
    }
  }, { timeout: 30000 });

  const responseBody = {
    received: items.length,
    updated,
    unchanged,
    quarantined,
    duplicates,
    discarded,
    discardedCodes: discardedCodes.slice(0, 100),
    account: {
      tradeName: account.businessName ?? account.slug,
      ownerEmail: account.users?.[0]?.email ?? null,
    },
    criticalProductsAlerts,
  };

  console.info(JSON.stringify({
    accountId: account.id,
    received: responseBody.received,
    updated: responseBody.updated,
    unchanged: responseBody.unchanged,
    quarantined: responseBody.quarantined,
    duplicates: responseBody.duplicates,
    discarded: responseBody.discarded,
    durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
  }));

  return res.status(200).json(responseBody);
});

export default router;
</file>

<file path="backend/src/utils/pagination.test.ts">
// backend/src/utils/pagination.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  parsePaginationParams,
  normalizeSearchText,
  DEFAULT_PAGE,
  DEFAULT_LIMIT,
  MAX_LIMIT,
  SORTABLE_FIELDS,
} from './pagination';

describe('pagination utility', () => {
  describe('parsePaginationParams', () => {
    it('aplica valores por defecto si no se envían parámetros', () => {
      const result = parsePaginationParams({});
      expect(result).toEqual({
        page: DEFAULT_PAGE,
        limit: DEFAULT_LIMIT,
        sortBy: 'name',
        order: 'asc',
        search: '',
      });
    });

    it('parsea page y limit correctamente si son números válidos', () => {
      const result = parsePaginationParams({ page: '2', limit: '50' });
      expect(result).toEqual({
        page: 2,
        limit: 50,
        sortBy: 'name',
        order: 'asc',
        search: '',
      });
    });

    it('usa los valores por defecto si page o limit son inválidos (letras, negativos, cero)', () => {
      expect(parsePaginationParams({ page: 'abc', limit: '-5' })).toEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({ page: DEFAULT_PAGE, limit: DEFAULT_LIMIT, search: '' })
      );
      expect(parsePaginationParams({ page: '0', limit: '0' })).toEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({ page: DEFAULT_PAGE, limit: DEFAULT_LIMIT, search: '' })
      );
    });

    it('limita el parámetro limit al máximo permitido (MAX_LIMIT)', () => {
      const result = parsePaginationParams({ limit: '999' });
      expect(result.limit).toBe(MAX_LIMIT);
    });

    it('permite ordenar por campos de la allowlist SORTABLE_FIELDS', () => {
      for (const field of SORTABLE_FIELDS) {
        const result = parsePaginationParams({ sortBy: field });
        expect(result.sortBy).toBe(field);
      }
    });

    it('usa "name" por defecto si sortBy no está en la allowlist', () => {
      const result = parsePaginationParams({ sortBy: 'campo_inexistente' });
      expect(result.sortBy).toBe('name');
    });

    it('parsea order de forma case-insensitive ("DESC" -> "desc")', () => {
      const result = parsePaginationParams({ order: 'DESC' });
      expect(result.order).toBe('desc');
    });

    it('usa "asc" por defecto si order es inválido o no se envía', () => {
      expect(parsePaginationParams({ order: 'invalid' }).order).toBe('asc');
      expect(parsePaginationParams({}).order).toBe('asc');
    });

    it('parsea el parámetro search recortando espacios y limitando a 100 caracteres', () => {
      const result = parsePaginationParams({ search: '  harina 000  ' });
      expect(result.search).toBe('harina 000');

      const longSearch = 'a'.repeat(150);
      expect(parsePaginationParams({ search: longSearch }).search).toHaveLength(100);
    });
  });

  describe('normalizeSearchText', () => {
    it('normaliza a minúsculas y elimina espacios iniciales/finales', () => {
      expect(normalizeSearchText('  HARINA 000  ')).toBe('harina 000');
    });

    it('elimina tildes simples y diacríticos estándar', () => {
      expect(normalizeSearchText('Semillas de sésamo')).toBe('semillas de sesamo');
      expect(normalizeSearchText('Azúcar')).toBe('azucar');
      expect(normalizeSearchText('Almidón')).toBe('almidon');
    });

    it('resuelve nombres con dos tildes', () => {
      expect(normalizeSearchText('Azúcar común')).toBe('azucar comun');
      expect(normalizeSearchText('azúcar común')).toBe('azucar comun');
      expect(normalizeSearchText('Almidón de maíz')).toBe('almidon de maiz');
      expect(normalizeSearchText('Jabón líquido')).toBe('jabon liquido');
    });

    it('descompone la letra ñ en n mediante NFD', () => {
      expect(normalizeSearchText('Cañoncitos con dulce de leche')).toBe('canoncitos con dulce de leche');
      expect(normalizeSearchText('cañoncitos')).toBe('canoncitos');
      expect(normalizeSearchText('CANONCITOS')).toBe('canoncitos');
    });

    it('maneja strings vacíos o compuestos solo por espacios', () => {
      expect(normalizeSearchText('')).toBe('');
      expect(normalizeSearchText('    ')).toBe('');
    });
  });
});
</file>

{
  "info": {
    "name": "MargenX - Alertas de margen (Insumos)",
    "description": "Casos de validación del contrato PUT /api/ingredients/:id para alertas de margen. Cubre cambio real, no-op, acceso no autorizado y conteo total vs críticos.",
    "schema": "https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json",
    "_postman_id": "8c1e8b6a-4fbe-4d4d-9f1d-6cbe1f4cbb7d"
  },
  "item": [
    {
      "name": "01 - Cambio real: affectedProductsCount total + criticalProducts subset",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });",
              "const body = pm.response.json();",
              "pm.test('El payload expone affectedProductsCount total', function () {",
              "  pm.expect(body.affectedProductsCount).to.be.a('number');",
              "  pm.expect(body.affectedProductsCount).to.be.greaterThan(0);",
              "});",
              "pm.test('criticalProducts contiene solo los críticos', function () {",
              "  pm.expect(body.criticalProducts).to.be.an('array');",
              "  pm.expect(body.criticalProducts.length).to.be.at.most(body.affectedProductsCount);",
              "});",
              "pm.test('La respuesta tiene la forma que consume el frontend', function () {",
              "  pm.expect(body).to.have.property('ingredient');",
              "  pm.expect(body).to.have.property('affectedProductsCount');",
              "  pm.expect(body).to.have.property('criticalProducts');",
              "});"
            ],
            "type": "text/javascript"
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "PUT",
        "header": [
          { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" },
          { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{adminToken}}" }
        ],
        "body": {
          "mode": "raw",
          "raw": "{\n  \"name\": \"Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense\",\n  \"unit\": \"kg\",\n  \"currentCost\": \"9500.00\"\n}"
        },
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients/{{ingredientId}}",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["ingredients", "{{ingredientId}}"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "02 - Sin cambio real: affectedProductsCount = 0 y criticalProducts = []",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "exec": [
              "// Reenvía el mismo currentCost que dejó el request 01 (9500.00), no el",
              "// costo base original (736.25): este request comparte el insumo con el",
              "// 01 dentro de la misma corrida, así que \"sin cambio real\" tiene que",
              "// probarse contra el valor vigente en este momento, no contra la base.",
              "pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });",
              "const body = pm.response.json();",
              "pm.test('No hubo cambio real', function () {",
              "  pm.expect(body.affectedProductsCount).to.eql(0);",
              "  pm.expect(body.criticalProducts).to.eql([]);",
              "});"
            ],
            "type": "text/javascript"
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "PUT",
        "header": [
          { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" },
          { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{adminToken}}" }
        ],
        "body": {
          "mode": "raw",
          "raw": "{\n  \"name\": \"Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense\",\n  \"unit\": \"kg\",\n  \"currentCost\": \"9500.00\"\n}"
        },
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients/{{ingredientId}}",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["ingredients", "{{ingredientId}}"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "03 - Colaborador: 403 Forbidden",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "exec": [
              "// Mensaje real de backend/src/middlewares/rbac.ts:52 (requireRole).",
              "pm.test('Status 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });",
              "pm.test('Se bloquea la mutación por RBAC', function () {",
              "  pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');",
              "});"
            ],
            "type": "text/javascript"
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "PUT",
        "header": [
          { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" },
          { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{collaboratorToken}}" }
        ],
        "body": {
          "mode": "raw",
          "raw": "{\n  \"name\": \"Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense\",\n  \"unit\": \"kg\",\n  \"currentCost\": \"9500.00\"\n}"
        },
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients/{{ingredientId}}",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["ingredients", "{{ingredientId}}"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "04 - Alert dispatch: payload enviado por n8n usa el total real y la lista crítica",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "exec": [
              "// Vuelve el costo a la base del seed (736.25, el costo activo post-seed",
              "// de la presentación mayorista por defecto - ver docs/qa/seed-data-comercios.md,",
              "// no el valor histórico declarado en prisma/seed.ts): es un cambio real",
              "// otra vez (esta vez hacia abajo), así que de paso deja la colección",
              "// reproducible sin una limpieza aparte y sin pisar el baseline que",
              "// usan otras colecciones y las suites E2E.",
              "pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });",
              "const body = pm.response.json();",
              "pm.test('El total real queda en affectedProductsCount', function () {",
              "  pm.expect(body.affectedProductsCount).to.be.a('number');",
              "  pm.expect(body.affectedProductsCount).to.be.greaterThan(0);",
              "});",
              "pm.test('La lista crítica es un subconjunto del total', function () {",
              "  pm.expect(body.criticalProducts.length).to.be.at.most(body.affectedProductsCount);",
              "});",
              "// La respuesta también incluye affectedProducts (la lista completa,",
              "// no solo el total): backend/src/routes/ingredients.ts:302-313.",
              "pm.test('La respuesta sigue el contrato esperado por el frontend', function () {",
              "  pm.expect(body).to.have.all.keys(['ingredient', 'affectedProductsCount', 'affectedProducts', 'criticalProducts']);",
              "});"
            ],
            "type": "text/javascript"
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "PUT",
        "header": [
          { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" },
          { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{adminToken}}" }
        ],
        "body": {
          "mode": "raw",
          "raw": "{\n  \"name\": \"Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense\",\n  \"unit\": \"kg\",\n  \"currentCost\": \"736.25\"\n}"
        },
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients/{{ingredientId}}",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["ingredients", "{{ingredientId}}"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    }
  ],
  "variable": [
    { "key": "baseUrl", "value": "http://localhost:3000/api" },
    { "key": "adminToken", "value": "<jwt-admin>" },
    { "key": "collaboratorToken", "value": "<jwt-colaborador>" },
    { "key": "ingredientId", "value": "30b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" }
  ]
}

{
  "info": {
    "name": "MargenX - Cuarentena API",
    "description": "Colección automatizada de pruebas API para la Cuarentena de Precios y gestión de presentaciones. Cubre: rechazo de precio, liberación de precio, visualización en el listado de proveedores y la validación que impide eliminar la última presentación predeterminada si hay otras (409).",
    "schema": "https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json"
  },
  "item": [
    {
      "name": "01 - Setup de Datos (Crear Insumo, Proveedor y Presentaciones)",
      "item": [
        {
          "name": "1. GET Extraer Slug de la Cuenta (Admin)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });",
                  "const json = pm.response.json();",
                  "pm.test('Obtuvo el slug', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(json.user.account.slug).to.exist;",
                  "    pm.environment.set('accountSlug', json.user.account.slug);",
                  "});"
                ],
                "type": "text/javascript"
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "GET",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/auth/me",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["auth", "me"]
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "2. POST Crear Insumo para Cuarentena",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",

                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });",

            "method": "POST",

            "body": {
              "mode": "raw",
              "raw": "{\n  \"name\": \"Insumo Cuarentena QA {{$timestamp}}\",\n  \"unit\": \"kg\",\n  \"currentCost\": \"100\"\n}"

            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["ingredients"]
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "3. POST Crear Proveedor A (Predeterminado)",

            },

          "request": {

<file path="backend/tests/postman/MargenX - Proveedores y Conversiones.postman_collection.json">
{
  "info": {
    "_postman_id": "f7a2c9e1-4b6d-4e3a-9c1f-7d2b8a5e6c30",
    "name": "MargenX - Proveedores y Conversiones",
    "description": "Colección automatizada de pruebas de API para el módulo de Proveedores y Empaques Mayoristas (issue #128 / #85). Cubre: alta de proveedor, asociación de insumo con cálculo exacto del costo unitario (packagePrice / packageSize), redondeo ROUND_HALF_UP al recalcular el proveedor predeterminado, inserción en PriceHistory, validaciones negativas de la fórmula y aislamiento multi-tenant entre dos cuentas.\n\nRequiere el backend corriendo localmente y dos tokens JWT de Clerk válidos (uno por cada cuenta piloto del seed) cargados en el environment antes de correr.\n\nVer README-ProveedoresConversiones.md en esta misma carpeta para instrucciones de ejecución con Newman.",
    "schema": "https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json"
  },

                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(201);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const schema = {",
                  "    type: 'object',",
                  "    required: ['ingredient'],",
                  "    properties: {",
                  "        ingredient: {",
                  "            type: 'object',",
                  "            required: ['id', 'accountId', 'name', 'unit', 'currentCost', 'updatedAt'],",
                  "            properties: {",
                  "                id: { type: 'string' },",
                  "                accountId: { type: 'string' },",
                  "                unit: { type: 'string', enum: ['kg', 'l', 'u'] },",

                  "    }",
                  "};",

                  "    pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(schema);",

                  "",
