    {
      "name": "02 - Asociacion y Calculo Exacto (Gherkin: 20 litros x $15.000 = $750,00)",
      "item": [
        {
          "name": "POST Asociar insumo con empaque de 20L a $15.000, predeterminado (201)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "// Escenario Gherkin de la issue: empaque de 20 litros por $15.000 =>",
                  "// costo unitario exacto de $750,00 (división exacta, sin redondeo).",
                  "pm.test('Status code es 201 Created', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(201);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const schema = {",
                  "    type: 'object',",
                  "    required: ['supplierIngredient', 'unitCost', 'ingredient', 'ingestEnabled'],",
                  "    properties: {",
                  "        supplierIngredient: {",
                  "            type: 'object',",
                  "            required: ['id', 'supplierId', 'ingredientId', 'packageSize', 'packageUnit', 'packagePrice', 'supplierCode', 'rawDescription', 'isDefault']",
                  "        },",
                  "        unitCost: { type: 'string' },",
                  "        ingredient: { type: 'object', required: ['id', 'currentCost'] },",
                  "        ingestEnabled: { type: 'boolean' }",
                  "    }",
                  "};",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El body respeta el schema de la asociación', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(schema);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const jsonData = pm.response.json();",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El costo unitario calculado es exactamente $750 (15000 / 20)', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.unitCost).to.eql('750');",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('La respuesta incluye ingestEnabled: true y registra el supplierCode', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.ingestEnabled).to.eql(true);",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.supplierIngredient.supplierCode).to.eql('ACE-20L');",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.supplierIngredient.rawDescription).to.eql('Aceite de Girasol Bidon 20L');",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('La asociación conserva los valores enviados y queda marcada como predeterminada', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.supplierIngredient.packageSize).to.eql('20');",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.supplierIngredient.packagePrice).to.eql('15000');",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.supplierIngredient.packageUnit).to.eql('l');",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.supplierIngredient.isDefault).to.eql(true);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El costo activo del insumo se actualizó al valor calculado', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.ingredient.currentCost).to.eql('750');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "POST",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" },
              { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" }
            ],
            "body": {
              "mode": "raw",
              "raw": "{\n  \"ingredientId\": \"{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}\",\n  \"packageSize\": \"20\",\n  \"packageUnit\": \"l\",\n  \"packagePrice\": \"15000\",\n  \"isDefault\": true,\n  \"supplierCode\": \"ACE-20L\",\n  \"rawDescription\": \"Aceite de Girasol Bidon 20L\"\n}",
              "options": { "raw": { "language": "json" } }
            },
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers/{{supplierId_cuentaA}}/ingredients",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaA}}", "ingredients"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "GET Consultar el insumo vinculado - currentCost refleja $750,00 exacto (200)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "// Paso \"Cuando se consulta el insumo vinculado en la API\" del Gherkin.",
                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(200);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const jsonData = pm.response.json();",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El campo currentCost refleja exactamente $750,00', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.ingredient.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('ingredientId_cuentaA'));",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.ingredient.currentCost).to.eql('750');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "GET",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients/{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["ingredients", "{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "GET Historial de precios - primer cambio registrado 100 -> 750 (200)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(200);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const schema = {",
                  "    type: 'object',",
                  "    required: ['history'],",
                  "    properties: { history: { type: 'array' } }",
                  "};",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El body respeta el schema de historial', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(schema);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const history = pm.response.json().history;",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('Se registró exactamente una entrada tras asociar el proveedor predeterminado', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(history.length).to.eql(1);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('La entrada refleja el cambio de costo 100 -> 750', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(history[0].oldCost).to.eql('100');",
                  "    pm.expect(history[0].newCost).to.eql('750');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "GET",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients/{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}/history",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["ingredients", "{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}", "history"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "03 - Precision Aritmetica (redondeo ROUND_HALF_UP al cambiar el predeterminado)",
      "item": [
        {
          "name": "POST Asociar el mismo insumo al segundo proveedor: 40L a $67, predeterminado (201)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "// Caso de borde de precisión: 67 / 40 = 1,675 exacto. ROUND_HALF_UP debe",
                  "// redondear el 3er decimal (5) hacia arriba -> 1,68 (no 1,67, que sería el",
                  "// resultado de un redondeo bancario/half-even incorrecto).",
                  "pm.test('Status code es 201 Created', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(201);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const jsonData = pm.response.json();",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El costo unitario redondea 1,675 hacia arriba a 1,68 (ROUND_HALF_UP)', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.unitCost).to.eql('1.68');",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El costo activo del insumo refleja el redondeo correcto', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.ingredient.currentCost).to.eql('1.68');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "POST",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" },
              { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" }
            ],
            "body": {
              "mode": "raw",
              "raw": "{\n  \"ingredientId\": \"{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}\",\n  \"packageSize\": \"40\",\n  \"packageUnit\": \"l\",\n  \"packagePrice\": \"67\",\n  \"isDefault\": true\n}",
              "options": { "raw": { "language": "json" } }
            },
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers/{{supplierId_cuentaA_2}}/ingredients",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaA_2}}", "ingredients"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "GET Consultar el insumo - costo unitario ahora refleja el redondeo (1.68) (200)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(200);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('currentCost quedó en 1.68 tras el cambio de predeterminado', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json().ingredient.currentCost).to.eql('1.68');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "GET",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients/{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["ingredients", "{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "GET Historial de precios - segunda entrada encadenada 750 -> 1.68 (200)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(200);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const history = pm.response.json().history;",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('Ahora hay dos entradas en orden cronológico', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(history.length).to.eql(2);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('La primera entrada sigue intacta (100 -> 750)', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(history[0].oldCost).to.eql('100');",
                  "    pm.expect(history[0].newCost).to.eql('750');",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('La segunda entrada encadena desde el costo anterior (750 -> 1.68)', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(history[1].oldCost).to.eql('750');",
                  "    pm.expect(history[1].newCost).to.eql('1.68');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "GET",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/ingredients/{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}/history",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["ingredients", "{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}", "history"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "04 - Validaciones Negativas de la Formula",
      "item": [
        {
          "name": "POST Validacion - tamano de empaque en 0 (400)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 400 Bad Request', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(400);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El mensaje indica que packageSize debe ser mayor a cero', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include('packageSize');",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include('mayor a cero');",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('No se creó ninguna asociación (sin campo supplierIngredient)', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property('supplierIngredient');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "POST",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" },
              { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" }
            ],
            "body": {
              "mode": "raw",
              "raw": "{\n  \"ingredientId\": \"{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}\",\n  \"packageSize\": \"0\",\n  \"packageUnit\": \"l\",\n  \"packagePrice\": \"100\"\n}",
              "options": { "raw": { "language": "json" } }
            },
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers/{{supplierId_cuentaA}}/ingredients",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaA}}", "ingredients"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "POST Validacion - precio de empaque negativo (400)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 400 Bad Request', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(400);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El mensaje indica que packagePrice debe ser mayor a cero', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include('packagePrice');",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include('mayor a cero');",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('No se creó ninguna asociación (sin campo supplierIngredient)', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property('supplierIngredient');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "POST",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" },
              { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" }
            ],
            "body": {
              "mode": "raw",
              "raw": "{\n  \"ingredientId\": \"{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}\",\n  \"packageSize\": \"10\",\n  \"packageUnit\": \"l\",\n  \"packagePrice\": \"-500\"\n}",
              "options": { "raw": { "language": "json" } }
            },
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers/{{supplierId_cuentaA}}/ingredients",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaA}}", "ingredients"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "05 - Aislamiento Multi-Tenant (Cuenta A contra datos de Cuenta B)",
      "item": [
        {
          "name": "POST Setup - Crear proveedor ajeno (Cuenta B) (201)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 201 Created', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(201);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const jsonData = pm.response.json();",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El proveedor pertenece a la Cuenta B, no a la Cuenta A', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.supplier.accountId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('accountId_cuentaB'));",
                  "    pm.expect(jsonData.supplier.accountId).to.not.eql(pm.environment.get('accountId_cuentaA'));",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.environment.set('supplierId_cuentaB', jsonData.supplier.id);"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "POST",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_B}}" },
              { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" }

            "body": {
              "mode": "raw",
              "raw": "{\n  \"name\": \"Proveedor Ajeno QA {{$timestamp}}\"\n}",
              "options": { "raw": { "language": "json" } }
            },
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "GET Listar proveedores (Cuenta A) no incluye el proveedor de Cuenta B (200)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "// Caso de prueba del alcance técnico: \"Cuenta A no puede listar... proveedores de Cuenta B\".",
                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(200);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "const ids = pm.response.json().suppliers.map((s) => s.id);",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('Control positivo: los proveedores propios de la Cuenta A sí aparecen', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get('supplierId_cuentaA'));",
                  "    pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get('supplierId_cuentaA_2'));",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El proveedor de la Cuenta B NO aparece en el listado de la Cuenta A', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.environment.get('supplierId_cuentaB'));",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "GET",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "GET Proveedor ajeno por id (Cuenta A contra Cuenta B) (404)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 404 Not Found (nunca 403, ni 200)', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(404);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El mensaje es el uniforme de recurso no encontrado', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Proveedor no encontrado.');",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('No se filtra información del proveedor ajeno', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property('supplier');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "GET",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers/{{supplierId_cuentaB}}",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaB}}"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "POST Asociar insumo usando un proveedor ajeno (Cuenta A -> Cuenta B) (404)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "// Caso de prueba del alcance técnico: \"Cuenta A no puede... asociar proveedores de Cuenta B\".",
                  "pm.test('Status code es 404 Not Found (nunca 403, ni 200/201)', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(404);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('El mensaje es el uniforme de recurso no encontrado', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Proveedor no encontrado.');",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('No se creó ninguna asociación cruzada entre cuentas', function () {",
                  "    pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property('supplierIngredient');",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "POST",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" },
              { "key": "Content-Type", "value": "application/json" }
            ],
            "body": {
              "mode": "raw",
              "raw": "{\n  \"ingredientId\": \"{{ingredientId_cuentaA}}\",\n  \"packageSize\": \"10\",\n  \"packageUnit\": \"l\",\n  \"packagePrice\": \"500\"\n}",
              "options": { "raw": { "language": "json" } }
            },
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers/{{supplierId_cuentaB}}/ingredients",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaB}}", "ingredients"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "06 - Limpieza (Cuenta A y Cuenta B)",
      "item": [
        {
          "name": "DELETE Cleanup - Eliminar proveedor ajeno de Cuenta B (200)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",

                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(200);",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "DELETE",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_B}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers/{{supplierId_cuentaB}}",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaB}}"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "DELETE Cleanup - Eliminar segundo proveedor de Cuenta A (200)",
          "event": [
            {
              "listen": "test",

                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(200);",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "DELETE",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_A}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/suppliers/{{supplierId_cuentaA_2}}",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaA_2}}"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        },
        {
          "name": "DELETE Cleanup - Eliminar primer proveedor de Cuenta A (200)",
          "event": [
            {

                "type": "text/javascript",

                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",

                  "});"

          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "DELETE",

              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["suppliers", "{{supplierId_cuentaA}}"]
            }
          },
          "response": []

        {
          "name": "DELETE Cleanup - Eliminar insumo de prueba, cascada PriceHistory (200)",
          "event": [

              "listen": "test",
              "script": {
                "type": "text/javascript",
                "exec": [
                  "// Deja la base como estaba antes del run: borrar el insumo elimina en",
                  "// cascada cualquier PriceHistory y SupplierIngredient remanente.",
                  "pm.test('Status code es 200 OK', function () {",
                  "    pm.response.to.have.status(200);",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('Confirma la eliminación', function () {",

{
  "info": {
    "name": "MargenX - Reportes API",
    "description": "Pruebas de contrato, autenticación interna, RBAC y paridad con /api/dashboard/metrics para reportes semanales.",
    "schema": "https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json",
    "_postman_id": "c9a8d7e6-5f4b-4a3c-9d2e-1b8f7a6c5d4e"
  },
  "variable": [
    { "key": "baseUrl", "value": "http://localhost:3000/api" },
    { "key": "adminToken", "value": "<jwt-admin>" },
    { "key": "collaboratorToken", "value": "<jwt-colaborador>" },
    { "key": "internalWebhookSecret", "value": "<secreto-interno>" },
    { "key": "validAccountSlug", "value": "panaderia-central" },
    { "key": "dashLossCount", "value": "" },
    { "key": "dashRiskCount", "value": "" },
    { "key": "dashTargetCount", "value": "" },
    { "key": "dashSurplusCount", "value": "" },
    { "key": "dashDraftCount", "value": "" },
    { "key": "dashAvgMargin", "value": "" }
  ],
  "item": [
    {
      "name": "01 - GET /api/dashboard/metrics (referencia de paridad)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Status 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });",
              "const d = pm.response.json();",
              "pm.collectionVariables.set('dashLossCount', String(d.lossCount));",
              "pm.collectionVariables.set('dashRiskCount', String(d.riskCount));",
              "pm.collectionVariables.set('dashTargetCount', String(d.targetCount));",
              "pm.collectionVariables.set('dashSurplusCount', String(d.surplusCount));",
              "pm.collectionVariables.set('dashDraftCount', String(d.draftCount));",
              "pm.collectionVariables.set('dashAvgMargin', String(d.averageMarginPercent));"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [{ "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{adminToken}}" }],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/dashboard/metrics",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["dashboard", "metrics"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "02 - GET /api/internal/reports/accounts sin secreto (401)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Status 401 Unauthorized', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });",
              "pm.test('Error Unauthorized', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Unauthorized'); });"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/internal/reports/accounts",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["internal", "reports", "accounts"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "03 - GET /api/internal/reports/accounts con secreto inválido (401)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Status 401 Unauthorized', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [{ "key": "x-margenx-webhook-secret", "value": "secreto-incorrecto" }],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/internal/reports/accounts",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["internal", "reports", "accounts"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "04 - GET /api/internal/reports/accounts con secreto válido (200)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Status 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });",
              "const accounts = pm.response.json().accounts;",
              "pm.test('Lista cuentas activas con slug, businessName y ownerEmail', function () {",
              "    pm.expect(accounts).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;",
              "    const panaderia = accounts.find(a => a.slug === pm.collectionVariables.get('validAccountSlug'));",
              "    pm.expect(panaderia).to.exist;",
              "    pm.expect(panaderia).to.include.all.keys('id', 'slug', 'businessName', 'ownerEmail');",
              "});"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [{ "key": "x-margenx-webhook-secret", "value": "{{internalWebhookSecret}}" }],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/internal/reports/accounts",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["internal", "reports", "accounts"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "05 - GET /api/internal/reports/weekly/:slug inexistente (404)",

        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {

          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [{ "key": "x-margenx-webhook-secret", "value": "{{internalWebhookSecret}}" }],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/internal/reports/weekly/slug-que-no-existe",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["internal", "reports", "weekly", "slug-que-no-existe"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "06 - GET /api/internal/reports/weekly/:slug válido (200 y paridad con dashboard)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Status 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });",
              "const body = pm.response.json();",
              "pm.test('Contiene todas las secciones del reporte semanal', function () {",
              "    pm.expect(body).to.include.all.keys(['account', 'period', 'generatedAt', 'catalogHealth', 'belowMinimumProducts', 'weeklyCostChanges', 'quarantine', 'purchasingSavings', 'staleCosts']);",
              "});",
              "pm.test('Coinciden buckets y mediana con /api/dashboard/metrics', function () {",
              "    const h = body.catalogHealth;",
              "    pm.expect(String(h.lossCount)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('dashLossCount'));",
              "    pm.expect(String(h.riskCount)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('dashRiskCount'));",
              "    pm.expect(String(h.targetCount)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('dashTargetCount'));",
              "    pm.expect(String(h.surplusCount)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('dashSurplusCount'));",
              "    pm.expect(String(h.draftCount)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('dashDraftCount'));",
              "    pm.expect(String(h.averageMarginPercent)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('dashAvgMargin'));",
              "});"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [{ "key": "x-margenx-webhook-secret", "value": "{{internalWebhookSecret}}" }],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/internal/reports/weekly/{{validAccountSlug}}",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["internal", "reports", "weekly", "{{validAccountSlug}}"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "07 - GET /api/reports/weekly sin token (401)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": ["pm.test('Status 401 Unauthorized', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });"]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/reports/weekly",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["reports", "weekly"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "08 - GET /api/reports/weekly como COLLABORATOR (403)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Status 403 Forbidden', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });",
              "pm.test('Mensaje RBAC de rol ADMIN', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.'); });"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [{ "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{collaboratorToken}}" }],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/reports/weekly",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["reports", "weekly"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    },
    {
      "name": "09 - GET /api/reports/weekly como ADMIN (200)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Status 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });",
              "const body = pm.response.json();",
              "pm.test('Devuelve el reporte de la cuenta autenticada', function () {",
              "    pm.expect(body.account.slug).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('validAccountSlug'));",
              "    pm.expect(body.belowMinimumProducts.items.length).to.be.at.most(20);",
              "    pm.expect(body.weeklyCostChanges.items.length).to.be.at.most(10);",
              "    pm.expect(body.quarantine.items.length).to.be.at.most(5);",
              "    pm.expect(body.purchasingSavings.items.length).to.be.at.most(5);",
              "});"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [{ "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{adminToken}}" }],

    {

        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {

      "request": {

              "pm.test('Mensaje uniforme de autenticación', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('No autorizado'); });"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",

        }

    },
    {
      "name": "12 - GET /api/reports/weekly.pdf como ADMIN (200 PDF o 503 genérico sin n8n)",
      "event": [
        {
          "listen": "test",
          "script": {
            "type": "text/javascript",
            "exec": [
              "pm.test('Responde 200 con PDF válido o 503 genérico si n8n no está disponible', function () {",
              "    pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code);",
              "});",
              "if (pm.response.code === 200) {",
              "    pm.test('Encabezados de descarga PDF correctos', function () {",
              "        pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/pdf');",
              "        pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.match(/^attachment; filename=\"margenx-reporte-\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.pdf\"$/);",
              "        pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('private, no-store');",
              "        pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Access-Control-Expose-Headers')).to.eql('Content-Disposition');",
              "    });",
              "    pm.test('El cuerpo inicia con firma %PDF-', function () {",
              "        pm.expect(pm.response.text().slice(0, 5)).to.eql('%PDF-');",
              "    });",
              "} else {",
              "    pm.test('503 con mensaje genérico sin filtrar detalles internos', function () {",
              "        const err = pm.response.json().error;",
              "        pm.expect(err).to.eql('No pudimos generar el reporte PDF en este momento. Probá de nuevo en unos minutos.');",
              "        pm.expect(err).to.not.match(/n8n|N8N_REPORT_PDF_WEBHOOK_URL|INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET|TimeoutError/i);",
              "    });",
              "}"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "header": [{ "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{adminToken}}" }],
        "url": {
          "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/reports/weekly.pdf",
          "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
          "path": ["reports", "weekly.pdf"]
        }
      },
      "response": []
    }
  ]
}
