                  "    pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.environment.get('productId_cuentaA'));",
                  "});",
                  "",
                  "pm.test('Ningún producto listado pertenece a la Cuenta A', function () {",
                  "    jsonData.data.forEach((product) => {",
                  "        pm.expect(product.accountId).to.not.eql(accountIdCuentaA);",
                  "    });",
                  "});"
                ]
              }
            }
          ],
          "request": {
            "method": "GET",
            "header": [
              { "key": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {{token_cuenta_B}}" }
            ],
            "url": {
              "raw": "{{baseUrl}}/products",
              "host": ["{{baseUrl}}"],
              "path": ["products"]
            }
          },
          "response": []
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
</file>

<file path="backend/prisma/seed-demo.ts">
/// <reference types="node" />
import "dotenv/config";
import { Prisma, PrismaClient, Role } from "@prisma/client";
import {
  calculateRecipeTotal,
  calculateMarginAmount,
  calculateMarginPercent,
  calculateUnitCost,
} from "../src/services/marginCalculator";
import { normalizeSearchText } from "../src/utils/pagination";
import { type DemoAuthProviderIds, hasIdentityConflict, resolveDemoAuthProviderIds } from "./seed-identity";

// Cuenta de demostración "Demo MargenX": script independiente de seed.ts.
// Datos 100% ficticios, importes en ARS. IDs fijos con prefijo 31..., distintos
// de los 30... del seed de QA, para poder re-ejecutar sin duplicar (upsert).
//
// Los usuarios deben existir previamente en Clerk (este script no los crea):
// el authProviderId es el user_id de Clerk de cada uno. Cada instancia de Clerk
// tiene sus propios IDs: los de abajo son los de desarrollo; en producción se
// pasan SEED_DEMO_ADMIN_AUTH_ID y SEED_DEMO_COLAB_AUTH_ID (docs/runbook-operacion.md).
//
// Re-ejecutar REINICIA el escenario de demo (costos, precios y la cuarentena
// pendiente vuelven al estado inicial).
//
// Alertas: el destinatario es el primer usuario ADMIN de la cuenta
// (demo-admin@margenx.tech); Account no tiene un campo ownerEmail.

const DEV_AUTH_PROVIDER_IDS: DemoAuthProviderIds = {
  admin: "user_3LHZsMObG8rtQEjZnIR9hB83047",
  collaborator: "user_3LHa1sLQjQk7uUtluUfEII9pbFR",
};

const ACCOUNT = {
  id: "31a00000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  businessName: "Demo MargenX",
  slug: "demo-margenx",
  users: [
    { id: "31d00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", email: "demo-admin@margenx.tech", role: Role.ADMIN, clerkRole: "admin" },
    { id: "31d00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", email: "demo-colab@margenx.tech", role: Role.COLLABORATOR, clerkRole: "collaborator" },
  ] as const,
};

const ING = {
  harina: "31b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  azucar: "31b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
  manteca: "31b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
  huevos: "31b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
  leche: "31b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000005",
  cacao: "31b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000006",
  dulceDeLeche: "31b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000007",
  aceite: "31b00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000008",
};

const ingredients = [
  { id: ING.harina, name: "Harina 000 (demo)", unit: "kg" },
  { id: ING.azucar, name: "Azúcar común (demo)", unit: "kg" },
  { id: ING.manteca, name: "Manteca (demo)", unit: "kg" },
  { id: ING.huevos, name: "Huevos (demo)", unit: "u" },
  { id: ING.leche, name: "Leche entera (demo)", unit: "l" },
  { id: ING.cacao, name: "Cacao amargo (demo)", unit: "kg" },
  { id: ING.dulceDeLeche, name: "Dulce de leche repostero (demo)", unit: "kg" },
  { id: ING.aceite, name: "Aceite de girasol (demo)", unit: "l" },
];

interface DemoSupplierItem {
  id: string;
  ingredientId: string;
  supplierCode?: string;
  rawDescription?: string;
  packageSize: string;
  packageUnit: string;
  packagePrice: string;
  isDefault: boolean;
  // Caso de cuarentena: precio propuesto pendiente de liberar o rechazar.
  pendingPackagePrice?: string;
  quarantineReason?: string;
}

const suppliers: Array<{
  id: string;
  name: string;
  contactPhone: string;
  email: string;
  address: string;
  ingredients: DemoSupplierItem[];
}> = [
  {
    id: "31c00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    name: "Proveedor Demo con códigos",
    contactPhone: "+54 11 5555-0101",
    email: "ventas@proveedor-demo-con-codigos.example",
    address: "Calle Ficticia 100, Ciudad Demo",
    ingredients: [
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", ingredientId: ING.harina, supplierCode: "DEMO-HAR-25", rawDescription: "HARINA 000 BOLSA 25KG", packageSize: "25.000", packageUnit: "kg", packagePrice: "21000.00", isDefault: true },
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", ingredientId: ING.azucar, supplierCode: "DEMO-AZU-10", rawDescription: "AZUCAR COMUN 10KG", packageSize: "10.000", packageUnit: "kg", packagePrice: "12000.00", isDefault: true },
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000003", ingredientId: ING.manteca, supplierCode: "DEMO-MAN-02", rawDescription: "MANTECA PAN 2KG", packageSize: "2.000", packageUnit: "kg", packagePrice: "19000.00", isDefault: true },
      // Cuarentena: 12000 -> 21000 por kg (+75 %), pendiente de revisión.
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000004", ingredientId: ING.cacao, supplierCode: "DEMO-CAC-01", rawDescription: "CACAO AMARGO 1KG", packageSize: "1.000", packageUnit: "kg", packagePrice: "12000.00", isDefault: true, pendingPackagePrice: "21000.00", quarantineReason: "VARIACION_MAYOR_50_POR_CIENTO" },
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000005", ingredientId: ING.dulceDeLeche, supplierCode: "DEMO-DDL-05", rawDescription: "DULCE DE LECHE REPOSTERO 5KG", packageSize: "5.000", packageUnit: "kg", packagePrice: "17500.00", isDefault: true },
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000006", ingredientId: ING.aceite, supplierCode: "DEMO-ACE-05", rawDescription: "ACEITE GIRASOL 5L", packageSize: "5.000", packageUnit: "l", packagePrice: "9000.00", isDefault: true },
    ],
  },
  {
    // Sin supplierCode: sirve para mostrar la carga manual de precios.
    id: "31c00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
    name: "Proveedor Demo sin códigos",
    contactPhone: "+54 11 5555-0102",
    email: "ventas@proveedor-demo-sin-codigos.example",
    address: "Avenida Inventada 200, Ciudad Demo",
    ingredients: [
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000007", ingredientId: ING.huevos, rawDescription: "Maple de huevos x30", packageSize: "30.000", packageUnit: "u", packagePrice: "7500.00", isDefault: true },
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000008", ingredientId: ING.leche, rawDescription: "Leche entera sachet, caja x12 L", packageSize: "12.000", packageUnit: "l", packagePrice: "14400.00", isDefault: true },
      { id: "31e00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000009", ingredientId: ING.azucar, rawDescription: "Azúcar 10 kg", packageSize: "10.000", packageUnit: "kg", packagePrice: "11500.00", isDefault: false },
    ],
  },
];

// Costos por kg/l/unidad con los precios de arriba: harina 840, azúcar 1200,
// manteca 9500, huevo 250, leche 1200, cacao 12000, dulce de leche 3500, aceite 1800.
const products = [
  {
    id: "31f00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    name: "Torta de chocolate — 1 unidad",
    salePrice: "9800.00",
    minMarginPercent: "30.00",
    recipe: [
      { ingredientId: ING.harina, quantity: "0.350" },
      { ingredientId: ING.azucar, quantity: "0.300" },
      { ingredientId: ING.manteca, quantity: "0.200" },
      { ingredientId: ING.huevos, quantity: "5.000" },
      { ingredientId: ING.leche, quantity: "0.250" },
      { ingredientId: ING.cacao, quantity: "0.080" },
    ],
  },
  {
    // Costo 3681 sobre venta 5200 => margen 29,21 % con mínimo 28 %: una suba
    // de ~5 % en la manteca cruza el mínimo y dispara la alerta.
    id: "31f00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
    name: "Alfajores de dulce de leche — docena",
    salePrice: "5200.00",
    minMarginPercent: "28.00",
    recipe: [
      { ingredientId: ING.harina, quantity: "0.400" },
      { ingredientId: ING.manteca, quantity: "0.150" },
      { ingredientId: ING.azucar, quantity: "0.100" },
      { ingredientId: ING.huevos, quantity: "3.000" },
      { ingredientId: ING.dulceDeLeche, quantity: "0.300" },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "31f00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
    name: "Pan de campo — 1 kg",
    salePrice: "2800.00",
    minMarginPercent: "35.00",
    recipe: [
      { ingredientId: ING.harina, quantity: "0.700" },
      { ingredientId: ING.aceite, quantity: "0.080" },
      { ingredientId: ING.azucar, quantity: "0.020" },
      { ingredientId: ING.leche, quantity: "0.300" },
    ],
  },
];

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

// Misma lógica de destino que confirmDatabaseTarget de seed.ts (host:puerto/base),
// pero con SEED_DEMO_CONFIRM. seed.ts no la exporta y no se modifica.
function confirmDatabaseTarget() {
  const connection = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
  if (!connection) {
    throw new Error("Falta DATABASE_URL. No se realizó la carga.");
  }

  const url = new URL(connection);
  if (!["postgres:", "postgresql:"].includes(url.protocol)) {
    throw new Error("El seed requiere una conexión PostgreSQL.");
  }

  const database = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(1));
  if (!url.hostname || !database) {
    throw new Error("DATABASE_URL debe indicar un host y una base de datos.");
  }

  // No muestra usuario, contraseña ni parámetros de conexión.
  const target = url.hostname + ":" + (url.port || "5432") + "/" + database;

  if (process.env.SEED_DEMO_CONFIRM !== target) {
    throw new Error(
      "Carga no autorizada. Destino detectado: " + target +
      ". Configurá SEED_DEMO_CONFIRM con ese valor exacto para confirmar que es la base correcta.",
    );
  }

  console.log("Destino confirmado:", target);
}

async function main() {
  confirmDatabaseTarget();
  const authProviderIds = resolveDemoAuthProviderIds(process.env, DEV_AUTH_PROVIDER_IDS);
  const users = ACCOUNT.users.map(({ clerkRole, ...user }) => ({ ...user, authProviderId: authProviderIds[clerkRole] }));

  const counts = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const matchingAccounts = await tx.account.findMany({
      where: { OR: [{ id: ACCOUNT.id }, { businessName: ACCOUNT.businessName }, { slug: ACCOUNT.slug }] },
    });
    if (matchingAccounts.some((row) =>
      row.id !== ACCOUNT.id || row.businessName !== ACCOUNT.businessName || row.slug !== ACCOUNT.slug
    )) {
      throw new Error("Conflicto de identidad en la cuenta " + ACCOUNT.businessName + ". No se adopta ni elimina ningún registro existente.");
    }

    await tx.account.upsert({
      where: { id: ACCOUNT.id },
      create: { id: ACCOUNT.id, businessName: ACCOUNT.businessName, slug: ACCOUNT.slug },
      update: { businessName: ACCOUNT.businessName, slug: ACCOUNT.slug },
    });

    for (const user of users) {
      const matchingUsers = await tx.user.findMany({
        where: { OR: [{ id: user.id }, { email: user.email }, { authProviderId: user.authProviderId }] },
      });
      // Mismo id con otro authProviderId es válido: la cuenta se resiembra
      // sobre otra instancia de Clerk y se actualiza el vínculo.
      if (matchingUsers.some((row) =>
        row.id !== user.id || row.accountId !== ACCOUNT.id || row.email !== user.email
      )) {
        throw new Error("Conflicto de identidad del usuario " + user.email + ".");
      }

      await tx.user.upsert({
        where: { id: user.id },
        create: { ...user, accountId: ACCOUNT.id },
        update: { role: user.role, authProviderId: user.authProviderId },
      });
    }

    // Costo unitario por insumo según su proveedor predeterminado.
    const costById = new Map<string, Prisma.Decimal>();
    for (const supplier of suppliers) {
      for (const item of supplier.ingredients) {
        if (!item.isDefault) continue;
        costById.set(
          item.ingredientId,
          calculateUnitCost(new Prisma.Decimal(item.packagePrice), new Prisma.Decimal(item.packageSize)),
        );
      }
    }

    for (const ingredient of ingredients) {
      const matching = await tx.ingredient.findMany({
        where: { OR: [{ id: ingredient.id }, { accountId: ACCOUNT.id, name: { equals: ingredient.name, mode: "insensitive" } }] },
      });
      if (hasIdentityConflict(matching, ingredient.id, ACCOUNT.id)) {
        throw new Error("Conflicto de identidad en el insumo " + ingredient.name + ".");
      }

      const cost = costById.get(ingredient.id);
      if (!cost) throw new Error("El insumo " + ingredient.name + " no tiene proveedor predeterminado.");

      const existing = matching.find((row) => row.id === ingredient.id);
      if (existing && !existing.currentCost.equals(cost)) {
        await tx.priceHistory.create({
          data: { ingredientId: ingredient.id, oldCost: existing.currentCost, newCost: cost },
        });
      }

      const values = {
        name: ingredient.name,
        searchName: normalizeSearchText(ingredient.name),
        unit: ingredient.unit,
        currentCost: cost,
      };
      await tx.ingredient.upsert({
        where: { id: ingredient.id },
        create: { id: ingredient.id, accountId: ACCOUNT.id, ...values },
        update: values,
      });
    }

    for (const supplier of suppliers) {
      const matching = await tx.supplier.findMany({
        where: { OR: [{ id: supplier.id }, { accountId: ACCOUNT.id, name: { equals: supplier.name, mode: "insensitive" } }] },
      });
      if (hasIdentityConflict(matching, supplier.id, ACCOUNT.id)) {
        throw new Error("Conflicto de identidad en el proveedor " + supplier.name + ".");
      }

      const supplierValues = {
        name: supplier.name,
        contactPhone: supplier.contactPhone,
        email: supplier.email,
        address: supplier.address,
        isActive: true,
      };
      await tx.supplier.upsert({
        where: { id: supplier.id },
        create: { id: supplier.id, accountId: ACCOUNT.id, ...supplierValues },
        update: supplierValues,
      });

      for (const item of supplier.ingredients) {
        const quarantined = item.pendingPackagePrice !== undefined;
        const values = {
          supplierCode: item.supplierCode ?? null,
          rawDescription: item.rawDescription ?? null,
          packageSize: new Prisma.Decimal(item.packageSize),
          packageUnit: item.packageUnit,
          packagePrice: new Prisma.Decimal(item.packagePrice),
          pendingPackagePrice: quarantined ? new Prisma.Decimal(item.pendingPackagePrice!) : null,
          isDefault: item.isDefault,
          isQuarantined: quarantined,
          quarantinedAt: quarantined ? new Date() : null,
          quarantineReason: quarantined ? item.quarantineReason ?? null : null,
        };
        await tx.supplierIngredient.upsert({
          where: { supplierId_ingredientId: { supplierId: supplier.id, ingredientId: item.ingredientId } },
          create: { id: item.id, supplierId: supplier.id, ingredientId: item.ingredientId, ...values },
          update: values,
        });
      }
    }

    for (const product of products) {
      const matching = await tx.product.findMany({
        where: { OR: [{ id: product.id }, { accountId: ACCOUNT.id, name: { equals: product.name, mode: "insensitive" } }] },
      });
      if (hasIdentityConflict(matching, product.id, ACCOUNT.id)) {
        throw new Error("Conflicto de identidad en el producto " + product.name + ".");
      }

      const salePrice = new Prisma.Decimal(product.salePrice);
      const cost = calculateRecipeTotal(
        product.recipe.map((item) => {
          const unitCost = costById.get(item.ingredientId);
          if (!unitCost) throw new Error("Receta de \"" + product.name + "\" referencia un insumo inexistente.");
          return { quantity: new Prisma.Decimal(item.quantity), unitCost };
        }),
      );

      const values = {
        name: product.name,
        searchName: normalizeSearchText(product.name),
        salePrice,
        minMarginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal(product.minMarginPercent),
        cost,
        marginAmount: calculateMarginAmount(salePrice, cost),
        marginPercent: calculateMarginPercent(salePrice, cost),
      };
      await tx.product.upsert({
        where: { id: product.id },
        create: { id: product.id, accountId: ACCOUNT.id, ...values },
        update: values,
      });

      for (const item of product.recipe) {
        await tx.productIngredient.upsert({
          where: { productId_ingredientId: { productId: product.id, ingredientId: item.ingredientId } },
          create: { productId: product.id, ingredientId: item.ingredientId, quantity: new Prisma.Decimal(item.quantity) },
          update: { quantity: new Prisma.Decimal(item.quantity) },
        });
      }
    }

    // Conteos acotados a la cuenta demo.
    const accountId = ACCOUNT.id;
    return [
      { tabla: "User", total: await tx.user.count({ where: { accountId } }) },
      { tabla: "Ingredient", total: await tx.ingredient.count({ where: { accountId } }) },
      { tabla: "Supplier", total: await tx.supplier.count({ where: { accountId } }) },
      { tabla: "SupplierIngredient", total: await tx.supplierIngredient.count({ where: { supplier: { accountId } } }) },
      { tabla: "SupplierIngredient en cuarentena", total: await tx.supplierIngredient.count({ where: { supplier: { accountId }, isQuarantined: true } }) },
      { tabla: "Product", total: await tx.product.count({ where: { accountId } }) },
      { tabla: "ProductIngredient", total: await tx.productIngredient.count({ where: { product: { accountId } } }) },
    ];
  }, { timeout: 30000 });

  console.log("Seed demo completado para la cuenta " + ACCOUNT.businessName + ".");
  console.table(counts);
}

main()
  .catch((error: unknown) => {
    console.error(
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Error inesperado al ejecutar el seed demo.",
    );
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });
</file>

<file path="backend/src/middlewares/errorHandler.test.ts">
// src/middlewares/errorHandler.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import express from 'express';
import request from 'supertest';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { errorHandler, AppError } from './errorHandler';

import type { Request, Response } from 'express';


function buildRes(): Response {
  const json = vi.fn();
  const status = vi.fn(() => ({ json }));
  // Cast doble justificado: es un test double parcial, no un objeto
  // Response real. "as unknown as X" es intencional (no un escape de any).
  return { status, json } as unknown as Response;
}

describe('errorHandler', () => {
  const req = {} as unknown as Request;
  const next = vi.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    delete process.env.NODE_ENV;
  });

  it('responde 400 ante JSON malformado', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = Object.assign(new SyntaxError('Unexpected token'), { body: '{' });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(400);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'El cuerpo de la solicitud contiene JSON inválido.',
    });
  });

  it('maneja errores genéricos como 500 (Catch-all)', () => {
    // 1. Forzamos el entorno a producción para este caso específico
    const originalEnv = process.env.NODE_ENV;
    process.env.NODE_ENV = 'production';
    
    // 2. Inicializamos 'res' usando la función auxiliar que ya tienes
    const res = buildRes();
    
    const genericErr = new Error('Database connection lost');
    
    // 3. Ejecutamos el middleware
    errorHandler(genericErr, req, res, next);
    
    // 4. Verificamos
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(500);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: 'Error interno del servidor.' });
    
    // 5. Restauramos el entorno
    process.env.NODE_ENV = originalEnv;
  });

  it('mapea P2002 de Prisma a 409 para asociación duplicada (Líneas 66-69)', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Unique violation', {
      code: 'P2002',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
      meta: { target: ['supplierId', 'ingredientId'] },
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(409);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'Ya existe una asociación de este insumo con el proveedor.',
    });
  });

  it('mapea P2002 de Prisma a 409 cuando se repite supplierCode para un mismo proveedor', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Unique violation', {
      code: 'P2002',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
      meta: { target: ['supplierId', 'supplierCode'] },
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(409);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'Ya existe una presentación con ese código para este proveedor.',
    });
  });

  it('mapea P2003 de Prisma a 409 (Línea 81)', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('FK violation', {
      code: 'P2003',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(409);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'La operación viola una relación existente con otro recurso.',
    });
  });

  it('mapea P2020 de Prisma a 400 (Línea 95)', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Overflow', {
      code: 'P2020',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(400);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'Uno de los valores numéricos excede la capacidad máxima admitida.',
    });
  });
  
  it('responde 413 con código estable cuando el cuerpo supera el límite permitido', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = Object.assign(new Error('request entity too large'), {
      type: 'entity.too.large',
      status: 413,
      statusCode: 413,
      expose: true,
    });

    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);

    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(413);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      code: 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE',
      error: 'La lista es demasiado grande. Dividila en varios lotes más pequeños.',
    });
  });

  it('incluye cabeceras de seguridad por defecto de Helmet', async () => {
    const app = express();
    app.use(helmet());
    app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
      res.json({ ok: true });
    });

    const response = await request(app).get('/health');

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(response.headers['x-dns-prefetch-control']).toBe('off');
    expect(response.headers['x-frame-options']).toBe('SAMEORIGIN');
    expect(response.headers['x-content-type-options']).toBe('nosniff');
  });

  it('responde 413 en otra ruta cuando el cuerpo supera el límite global', async () => {
    const app = express();
    app.use(express.json({ limit: '256kb' }));
    app.post('/api/other', (_req, res) => {
      res.json({ ok: true });
    });
    app.use(errorHandler);

    const response = await request(app)
      .post('/api/other')
      .send({ payload: 'x'.repeat(1_000_000) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(413);
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({
      code: 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE',
      error: expect.stringContaining('demasiado grande'),
    });
    expect(response.status).not.toBe(500);
  });

  it('respeta status y mensaje de un AppError', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    errorHandler(new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404), req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(404);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: 'Insumo no encontrado.' });
  });

  it('mapea P2025 de Prisma a 404', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Not found', {
      code: 'P2025',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(404);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: 'Recurso no encontrado.' });
  });

  it('mapea P2002 de Prisma a 409', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Unique violation', {
      code: 'P2002',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(409);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'Ya existe un registro con esos datos únicos.',
    });
  });

  it('mapea P2002 de Prisma a 409 para Supplier con nombre duplicado', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Unique violation', {
      code: 'P2002',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
      meta: { target: ['accountId', 'name'], modelName: 'Supplier' },
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(409);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'Ya existe un proveedor con ese nombre.',
    });
  });

  it('mapea P2002 de Prisma a 409 para Product con nombre duplicado', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Unique violation', {
      code: 'P2002',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
      meta: { target: ['accountId', 'name'], modelName: 'Product' },
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(409);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'Ya existe un producto con ese nombre.',
    });
  });

  it.each([
    ['Supplier', 'Ya existe un proveedor con ese nombre.'],
    ['Ingredient', 'Ya existe un insumo con ese nombre.'],
    ['Product', 'Ya existe un producto con ese nombre.'],
  ])('mapea P2002 del índice %s_accountId_lower_name_key a 409 (target como lista o como texto)', (model, message) => {
    for (const target of [[`${model}_accountId_lower_name_key`], `${model}_accountId_lower_name_key`]) {
      const res = buildRes();
      const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Unique violation', {
        code: 'P2002',
        clientVersion: '6.19.3',
        meta: { target },
      });
      errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
      expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(409);
      expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: message });
    }
  });

  it('mapea P2003 de Prisma a 409', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('FK violation', {
      code: 'P2003',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(409);
  });

  it('mapea P2020 de Prisma a 400 cuando hay overflow numérico', () => {
    const res = buildRes();
    const err = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('numeric field overflow', {
      code: 'P2020',
      clientVersion: '6.19.3',
    });
    errorHandler(err, req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(400);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      error: 'Uno de los valores numéricos excede la capacidad máxima admitida.',
    });
  });

  it('oculta el detalle del error en producción', () => {
    process.env.NODE_ENV = 'production';
    const res = buildRes();
    errorHandler(new Error('detalle interno sensible'), req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(500);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: 'Error interno del servidor.' });
  });

  it('expone el mensaje del error en desarrollo', () => {
    process.env.NODE_ENV = 'development';
    const res = buildRes();
    errorHandler(new Error('detalle interno sensible'), req, res, next);
    expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(500);
    expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: 'detalle interno sensible' });
  });
});
</file>

<file path="backend/src/middlewares/rbac.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import express from 'express';
import request from 'supertest';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

import type { AuthenticatedRequest } from './auth';
import type { Response, NextFunction } from 'express';

import { blockCollaboratorMutations } from './rbac';

const productFindManyMock = vi.fn();
const productCountMock = vi.fn();
const findManyIngredientMock = vi.fn();
const countIngredientMock = vi.fn();
const supplierFindManyMock = vi.fn();
const ingredientFindFirstMock = vi.fn();
const accountUpdateMock = vi.fn();

const authMiddlewareMock = vi.fn((req: AuthenticatedRequest, _res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  const role = (req.headers['x-role'] as string | undefined) === 'COLLABORATOR' ? 'COLLABORATOR' : 'ADMIN';
  req.user = { id: 'user-1', accountId: 'account-1', email: 'a@a.com', role };
  next();
});

vi.mock('../middlewares/auth', () => ({
  authMiddleware: (...args: Parameters<typeof authMiddlewareMock>) => authMiddlewareMock(...args),
}));

vi.mock('../lib/prisma', () => ({
  prisma: {
    product: {
      findMany: (...args: unknown[]) => productFindManyMock(...args),
      count: (...args: unknown[]) => productCountMock(...args),
    },
    ingredient: {
      findMany: (...args: unknown[]) => findManyIngredientMock(...args),
      count: (...args: unknown[]) => countIngredientMock(...args),
      findFirst: (...args: unknown[]) => ingredientFindFirstMock(...args),
    },
    supplier: {
      findMany: (...args: unknown[]) => supplierFindManyMock(...args),
    },
    priceHistory: {
      findMany: vi.fn(),
    },
    account: {
      update: (...args: unknown[]) => accountUpdateMock(...args),
    },
  },
}));

import productsRouter from '../routes/products';
import ingredientsRouter from '../routes/ingredients';
import suppliersRouter from '../routes/suppliers';
import { errorHandler } from './errorHandler';
import { requireRole, sanitizeFinancialData } from './rbac';
import authRoutes from '../routes/auth';

function buildApp(path: string, router: express.Router) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use(path, router);
  app.use(errorHandler);
  return app;
}

beforeEach(() => {
  productFindManyMock.mockReset();
  productCountMock.mockReset();
  findManyIngredientMock.mockReset();
  countIngredientMock.mockReset();
  supplierFindManyMock.mockReset();
  ingredientFindFirstMock.mockReset();
  accountUpdateMock.mockReset();
});

describe('rbac middleware', () => {
  it('requireRole: sin usuario responde 401', () => {
    const next = vi.fn();
    const noUserReq = { user: undefined } as unknown as AuthenticatedRequest;
    const res = {} as Response;

    requireRole(['ADMIN'])(noUserReq, res, next);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ message: 'No autorizado', statusCode: 401 }));
  });

  it('requireRole: con rol no permitido responde 403 con el rol requerido', () => {
    const next = vi.fn();
    const req = {
      user: { id: 'u1', accountId: 'a1', email: 'a@a.com', role: 'COLLABORATOR' },
    } as unknown as AuthenticatedRequest;

    requireRole(['ADMIN'])(req, {} as Response, next);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ message: 'Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.', statusCode: 403 }));

    const multiRoleNext = vi.fn();
    const multiRoleReq = {
      user: { id: 'u1', accountId: 'a1', email: 'a@a.com', role: 'OTHER' as any },
    } as unknown as AuthenticatedRequest;
    requireRole(['ADMIN', 'COLLABORATOR'])(multiRoleReq, {} as Response, multiRoleNext);
    expect(multiRoleNext).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ message: 'Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN o COLLABORATOR.', statusCode: 403 }));

    const emptyRoleNext = vi.fn();
    const emptyRoleReq = {
      user: { id: 'u1', accountId: 'a1', email: 'a@a.com', role: 'OTHER' as any },
    } as unknown as AuthenticatedRequest;
    requireRole([])(emptyRoleReq, {} as Response, emptyRoleNext);
    expect(emptyRoleNext).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ message: 'Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol un rol válido.', statusCode: 403 }));
  });

  it('requireRole: con rol permitido llama next()', () => {
    const next = vi.fn();
    const req = {
      user: { id: 'u1', accountId: 'a1', email: 'a@a.com', role: 'COLLABORATOR' },
    } as unknown as AuthenticatedRequest;

    requireRole(['COLLABORATOR'])(req, {} as Response, next);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledWith();
  });

  it('sanitizeFinancialData: elimina defaultMinMarginPercent y otros campos financieros en objetos anidados', () => {
    const next = vi.fn();
    const req = { user: { role: 'COLLABORATOR' } } as AuthenticatedRequest;
    const payload = {
      account: {
        defaultMinMarginPercent: 15,
        businessName: 'Panadería',
      },
      product: {
        salePrice: 250,
        packagePrice: 200,
        currentCost: 150,
        ingredients: [{ unitCost: 10, quantity: 2, ingredient: { currentCost: 12, name: 'Harina' } }],
      },
      nested: [{ marginPercent: 40 }, { oldCost: 50 }],
    };

    const originalJson = vi.fn();
    const res = {
      json: originalJson,
      setHeader: vi.fn(),
    } as unknown as Response;

    sanitizeFinancialData(req, res, next);
    (res as unknown as { json: (body: unknown) => unknown }).json(payload);
    const returned = originalJson.mock.calls[0]?.[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;

    expect(returned).toBeDefined();
    expect(returned!.account).toEqual({ businessName: 'Panadería' });
    expect(returned!.product).toEqual({ salePrice: 250, ingredients: [{ ingredient: { name: 'Harina' } }] });
    expect(returned!.nested).toEqual([{}, {}]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(returned!)).not.toMatch(/defaultMinMarginPercent|marginPercent|oldCost|packagePrice|unitCost|currentCost|quantity/i);
  });

  it('sanitizeFinancialData: no-op para ADMIN y no muta el objeto original', () => {
    const next = vi.fn();
    const req = { user: { role: 'ADMIN' } } as AuthenticatedRequest;
    const payload = { cost: 100, marginPercent: 25 };
    const res = { json: vi.fn(), setHeader: vi.fn() } as unknown as Response;

    sanitizeFinancialData(req, res, next);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(payload).toEqual({ cost: 100, marginPercent: 25 });
  });

  it('COLABORADOR: conserva Decimal y Date y elimina campos financieros de la respuesta real', async () => {
    productFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([
      {
        id: 'p1',
        name: 'Pan',
        salePrice: new Prisma.Decimal('250.00'),
        cost: new Prisma.Decimal('150.00'),
        marginAmount: new Prisma.Decimal('100.00'),
        marginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('40.00'),
        minMarginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('30.00'),
        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
        ingredients: [{ ingredientId: 'i1', quantity: new Prisma.Decimal('2.00') }],
      },
    ]);
    productCountMock.mockResolvedValue(1);

    const res = await request(buildApp('/api/products', productsRouter))
      .get('/api/products')
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data[0].salePrice).toBe('250');
    expect(res.body.data[0].updatedAt).toBe('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('cost');
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('marginAmount');
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('marginPercent');
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('minMarginPercent');
    expect(JSON.stringify(res.body)).not.toMatch(/cost|margin/i);
  });

  it('COLABORADOR: bloquea POST, PUT y DELETE en productos e ingredientes', async () => {
    const productRes = await request(buildApp('/api/products', productsRouter))
      .post('/api/products')
      .send({ name: 'Pan', salePrice: 150, minMarginPercent: 20, ingredients: [] })
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(productRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(productRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');

    const putRes = await request(buildApp('/api/products', productsRouter))
      .put('/api/products/p1')
      .send({ name: 'Pan' })
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(putRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(putRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');

    const deleteProductRes = await request(buildApp('/api/products', productsRouter))
      .delete('/api/products/p1')
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');
    expect(deleteProductRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(deleteProductRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');

    const ingredientPostRes = await request(buildApp('/api/ingredients', ingredientsRouter))
      .post('/api/ingredients')
      .send({ name: 'Harina', unit: 'kg', currentCost: '10' })
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(ingredientPostRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(ingredientPostRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');

    const ingredientPutRes = await request(buildApp('/api/ingredients', ingredientsRouter))
      .put('/api/ingredients/i1')
      .send({ name: 'Harina', unit: 'kg', currentCost: '12' })
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(ingredientPutRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(ingredientPutRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');

    const ingredientDeleteRes = await request(buildApp('/api/ingredients', ingredientsRouter))
      .delete('/api/ingredients/i1')
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(ingredientDeleteRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(ingredientDeleteRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');
  });

  it('COLABORADOR: no puede abrir historial de costos ni consultar proveedores ni productos de un insumo', async () => {
    ingredientFindFirstMock.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'i1' });

    const historyRes = await request(buildApp('/api/ingredients', ingredientsRouter))
      .get('/api/ingredients/i1/history')
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(historyRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(historyRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');

    const productsRes = await request(buildApp('/api/ingredients', ingredientsRouter))
      .get('/api/ingredients/i1/products')
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(productsRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(productsRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');

    const suppliersRes = await request(buildApp('/api/suppliers', suppliersRouter))
      .get('/api/suppliers')
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(suppliersRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(suppliersRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');
  });

  it('ADMIN: conserva los datos financieros y puede consultar rutas protegidas', async () => {
    productFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([
      {
        id: 'p1',
        name: 'Pan',
        salePrice: new Prisma.Decimal('250.00'),
        cost: new Prisma.Decimal('150.00'),
        marginAmount: new Prisma.Decimal('100.00'),
        marginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('40.00'),
        minMarginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('30.00'),
        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
        ingredients: [{ ingredientId: 'i1', quantity: new Prisma.Decimal('2.00') }],
      },
    ]);
    productCountMock.mockResolvedValue(1);

    const res = await request(buildApp('/api/products', productsRouter)).get('/api/products');

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data[0].cost).toBe('150');
    expect(res.body.data[0].marginPercent).toBe('40');
    expect(res.body.data[0].minMarginPercent).toBe('30');
  });

  it('GET /api/auth/me filtra defaultMinMarginPercent para COLLABORATOR y lo expone para ADMIN', async () => {
    const adminUser: NonNullable<AuthenticatedRequest['user']> = {
      id: 'user-1',
      accountId: 'account-1',
      email: 'a@a.com',
      role: 'ADMIN',
      account: {
        id: 'account-1',
        businessName: 'Panadería Central',
        defaultMinMarginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('15.5'),
        slug: 'panaderia-central',
      },
    };

    authMiddlewareMock.mockImplementationOnce((req, _res, next) => {
      req.user = { ...adminUser };
      next();
    });

    const adminRes = await request(buildApp('/api/auth', authRoutes)).get('/api/auth/me');
    expect(adminRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(adminRes.body.user.account.defaultMinMarginPercent.toString()).toBe('15.5');

    authMiddlewareMock.mockImplementationOnce((req, _res, next) => {
      req.user = {
        ...adminUser,
        role: 'COLLABORATOR',
      };
      next();
    });

    const collaboratorRes = await request(buildApp('/api/auth', authRoutes)).get('/api/auth/me');
    expect(collaboratorRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(collaboratorRes.body.user.account).toEqual({ id: 'account-1', businessName: 'Panadería Central' });
    expect(collaboratorRes.body.user.account).not.toHaveProperty('defaultMinMarginPercent');
  });

  it('PATCH /api/auth/account/margin rechaza COLLABORATOR y no invoca Prisma', async () => {
    authMiddlewareMock.mockImplementationOnce((req, _res, next) => {
      req.user = {
        id: 'user-1',
        accountId: 'account-1',
        email: 'a@a.com',
        role: 'COLLABORATOR',
        account: {
          id: 'account-1',
          businessName: 'Panadería Central',
          defaultMinMarginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('15.5'),
          slug: 'panaderia-central',
        },
      };
      next();
    });

    const collaboratorRes = await request(buildApp('/api/auth', authRoutes))
      .patch('/api/auth/account/margin')
      .send({ defaultMinMarginPercent: 20 })
      .set('Content-Type', 'application/json');

    expect(collaboratorRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(collaboratorRes.body.error).toBe('Acceso denegado. Se requiere rol ADMIN.');
    expect(accountUpdateMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('devuelve el cuerpo original si es undefined en sanitizeFinancialData (Línea 25-26)', () => {
    const req = { user: { role: 'COLLABORATOR' } } as any;
    const res = { setHeader: vi.fn(), json: vi.fn() } as any;
    const next = vi.fn();
    
    sanitizeFinancialData(req, res, next);
    // El middleware inyecta el json interceptor. Si llamamos json(undefined), debe ser transparente.
    const jsonInterceptor = res.json;
    const result = jsonInterceptor(undefined);
    expect(result).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('retorna 401 si no hay usuario en blockCollaboratorMutations (Línea 61-62)', () => {
    const req = { method: 'POST' } as any;
    const res = {} as any;
    const next = vi.fn();
    blockCollaboratorMutations(req, res, next);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ statusCode: 401 }));
  });
});
</file>

<file path="backend/src/routes/ingredients.ts">
import { Router, Response } from 'express';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../lib/prisma';
import { authMiddleware, AuthenticatedRequest } from '../middlewares/auth';
import { AppError } from '../middlewares/errorHandler';
import { blockCollaboratorMutations, requireRole, sanitizeFinancialData } from '../middlewares/rbac';
import {
  DEFAULT_PAGE,
  DEFAULT_LIMIT,
  MAX_LIMIT,
  parsePaginationParams,
  normalizeSearchText,
} from '../utils/pagination';
import { parseArgentineDecimal } from '../utils/argentineNumber';
import {
  applyIngredientCostChange,
  classifyProductHealthBucket,
} from '../services/marginCalculator';
import { dispatchMarginAlertEvent } from '../services/marginAlertDispatcher';

const router = Router();

router.use(authMiddleware);
router.use(blockCollaboratorMutations);
router.use(sanitizeFinancialData);

function getIdParam(rawId: string | string[] | undefined): string {
  if (Array.isArray(rawId)) {
    return rawId[0] ?? '';
  }
  return rawId ?? '';
}

const PRODUCT_USAGE_SORTABLE_FIELDS = ['name', 'quantity', 'salePrice', 'cost', 'marginPercent'] as const;
type ProductUsageSortField = (typeof PRODUCT_USAGE_SORTABLE_FIELDS)[number];

interface IngredientProductsPaginationParams {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  sortBy: ProductUsageSortField;
  order: 'asc' | 'desc';
  search: string;
}

function parseIngredientProductsPaginationParams(
  query: Record<string, unknown>
): IngredientProductsPaginationParams {
  const rawPage = Number(query.page);
  const page = Number.isInteger(rawPage) && rawPage > 0 ? rawPage : DEFAULT_PAGE;

  const rawLimit = Number(query.limit);
  const limit =
    Number.isInteger(rawLimit) && rawLimit > 0 ? Math.min(rawLimit, MAX_LIMIT) : DEFAULT_LIMIT;

  const rawSortBy = typeof query.sortBy === 'string' ? query.sortBy : '';
  const sortBy = (PRODUCT_USAGE_SORTABLE_FIELDS as readonly string[]).includes(rawSortBy)
    ? (rawSortBy as ProductUsageSortField)
    : 'name';

  const rawOrder = typeof query.order === 'string' ? query.order.toLowerCase() : '';
  const order = rawOrder === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';

  const rawSearch = typeof query.search === 'string' ? query.search.trim() : '';
  const search = rawSearch.slice(0, 100);

  return { page, limit, sortBy, order, search };
}

function buildIngredientProductsOrderBy(
  sortBy: ProductUsageSortField,
  order: 'asc' | 'desc'
): Prisma.ProductIngredientOrderByWithRelationInput {
  switch (sortBy) {
    case 'quantity':
      return { quantity: order };
    case 'salePrice':
      return { product: { salePrice: order } };
    case 'cost':
      return { product: { cost: order } };
    case 'marginPercent':
      return { product: { marginPercent: order } };
    case 'name':
    default:
      return { product: { name: order } };
  }
}

const VALID_UNITS = ['kg', 'l', 'u'] as const;
type Unit = (typeof VALID_UNITS)[number];
const MAX_MONEY_VALUE = new Prisma.Decimal('99999999.99');
const BULK_MAX_ROWS = 500;

interface IngredientInputDTO {
  name?: unknown;
  unit?: unknown;
  currentCost?: unknown;
}

interface ValidatedIngredientInput {
  name: string;
  unit: Unit;
  currentCost: Prisma.Decimal;
}

function validateIngredientInput(
  body: IngredientInputDTO
): { data: ValidatedIngredientInput } | { errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];

  const name = typeof body.name === 'string' ? body.name.trim() : '';
  if (!name) {
    errors.push('El campo "name" es obligatorio y debe ser un texto no vacío.');
  }

  const unit = typeof body.unit === 'string' ? body.unit.trim() : '';
  if (!VALID_UNITS.includes(unit as Unit)) {
    errors.push(`El campo "unit" debe ser uno de: ${VALID_UNITS.join(', ')}.`);
  }

  let currentCost: Prisma.Decimal | null = null;
  const rawCost = body.currentCost;

  if (
    rawCost === undefined ||
    rawCost === null ||
    (typeof rawCost === 'string' && rawCost.trim() === '')
  ) {
    errors.push('El campo "currentCost" es obligatorio.');
  } else {
    try {
      const decimalValue = parseArgentineDecimal(rawCost, 'currentCost');
      if (decimalValue.lessThanOrEqualTo(0)) {
        errors.push('El campo "currentCost" debe ser mayor a cero.');
      } else if (decimalValue.decimalPlaces() > 2) {
        errors.push('El campo "currentCost" debe ser un valor decimal válido (ej: "742.98").');
      } else if (decimalValue.abs().greaterThan(MAX_MONEY_VALUE)) {
        errors.push('El insumo no puede superar $99.999.999,99.');
      } else {
        currentCost = decimalValue;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push((error as Error).message || 'El campo "currentCost" debe ser un valor decimal válido.');
    }
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return { errors };
  }

  return {
    data: {
      name,
      unit: unit as Unit,
      currentCost: currentCost as Prisma.Decimal,
    },
  };
}

function parseIngredientInput(body: IngredientInputDTO): ValidatedIngredientInput {
  const validation = validateIngredientInput(body);
  if ('errors' in validation) {
    throw new AppError(validation.errors.join(' '), 400);
  }
  return validation.data;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* GET /api/ingredients                                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.get('/', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const query = { ...(req.query as Record<string, unknown>) };

  if (req.user!.role === 'COLLABORATOR') {
    const rawSortBy = typeof query.sortBy === 'string' ? query.sortBy : '';
    if (!['name', 'updatedAt'].includes(rawSortBy)) {
      query.sortBy = 'name';
    }
  }

  const { page, limit, sortBy, order, search } = parsePaginationParams(query);
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const where: Prisma.IngredientWhereInput = { accountId };
  if (search) {
    const normalized = normalizeSearchText(search);
    where.OR = [
      { searchName: { contains: normalized, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      { name: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
    ];
  }

  const [data, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.ingredient.findMany({
      where,
      omit: { searchName: true },
      include: {
        suppliers: {
          include: {
            supplier: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { [sortBy]: order },
      skip,
      take: limit,
    }),
    prisma.ingredient.count({ where }),
  ]);

  const totalPages = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / limit);

  return res.status(200).json({
    data,
    meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages },
  });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* GET /api/ingredients/:id                                            */
/* Incluye presentaciones de proveedores asociadas para rol ADMIN.     */
/* (RBAC sanitizeFinancialData limpia 'suppliers' para COLLABORATOR)   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.get('/:id', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const ingredient = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    omit: { searchName: true },
    include: {
      suppliers: {
        include: {
          supplier: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!ingredient) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  return res.status(200).json({ ingredient });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* GET /api/ingredients/:id/history                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.get('/:id/history', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const ingredient = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  if (!ingredient) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const history = await prisma.priceHistory.findMany({
    where: { ingredientId: id },
    orderBy: { changedAt: 'asc' },
  });

  return res.status(200).json({ history });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* GET /api/ingredients/:id/products                                   */
/* Lista paginada de productos cuya receta utiliza el insumo.          */
/* Solo ADMIN; acotado estrictamente por accountId.                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.get('/:id/products', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const ingredient = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  if (!ingredient) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const { page, limit, sortBy, order, search } = parseIngredientProductsPaginationParams(
    req.query as Record<string, unknown>
  );
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const where: Prisma.ProductIngredientWhereInput = {
    ingredientId: id,
    product: {
      accountId,
      ...(search
        ? {
            OR: [
              { searchName: { contains: normalizeSearchText(search), mode: 'insensitive' } },
              { name: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
            ],
          }
        : {}),
    },
  };

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.productIngredient.findMany({
      where,
      select: {
        quantity: true,
        product: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            salePrice: true,
            cost: true,
            marginAmount: true,
            marginPercent: true,
            minMarginPercent: true,
            updatedAt: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: buildIngredientProductsOrderBy(sortBy, order),
      skip,
      take: limit,
    }),
    prisma.productIngredient.count({ where }),
  ]);

  const data = rows.map((row) => {
    const marginStatus = classifyProductHealthBucket(
      new Prisma.Decimal(row.product.marginPercent ?? 0),
      new Prisma.Decimal(row.product.minMarginPercent ?? 0),
      1
    );

    return {
      id: row.product.id,
      name: row.product.name,
      quantity: row.quantity,
      salePrice: row.product.salePrice,
      cost: row.product.cost,
      marginAmount: row.product.marginAmount,
      marginPercent: row.product.marginPercent,
      minMarginPercent: row.product.minMarginPercent,
      marginStatus,
      updatedAt: row.product.updatedAt,
    };
  });

  const totalPages = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / limit);

  return res.status(200).json({
    data,
    meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages },
  });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* POST /api/ingredients                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.post('/', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const { name, unit, currentCost } = parseIngredientInput(req.body as IngredientInputDTO);

  const existing = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { accountId, name: { equals: name, mode: 'insensitive' } },
  });
  if (existing) {
    throw new AppError('Ya existe un insumo con ese nombre.', 409);
  }

  const ingredient = await prisma.ingredient.create({
    omit: { searchName: true },
    data: {
      name,
      searchName: normalizeSearchText(name),
      unit,
      currentCost,
      accountId,
    },
  });

  return res.status(201).json({ ingredient });
});

/**
 * Carga masiva de insumos por planilla.
 */
router.post('/bulk', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const rawPayload = req.body as unknown;
  const rows: unknown[] = Array.isArray(rawPayload)
    ? rawPayload
    : Array.isArray((rawPayload as { rows?: unknown[] } | null)?.rows)
      ? (rawPayload as { rows: unknown[] }).rows
      : [];

  if (!Array.isArray(rawPayload) && !Array.isArray((rawPayload as { rows?: unknown[] } | null)?.rows)) {
    throw new AppError('La carga masiva debe enviarse como un array de filas.', 400);
  }

  if (rows.length > BULK_MAX_ROWS) {
    throw new AppError(
      `La lista supera el tope de ${BULK_MAX_ROWS} filas por lote. Dividila en varios lotes más pequeños.`,
      413
    );
  }

  const errors: Array<{ row: number; reason: string }> = [];
  const validRows: Array<{ name: string; searchName: string; unit: Unit; cost: Prisma.Decimal }> = [];
  const existingNames = new Set(
    (await prisma.ingredient.findMany({
      where: { accountId },
      select: { name: true },
    })).map((row) => row.name.trim().toLowerCase())
  );
  const seenInBatch = new Set<string>();
  let skipped = 0;

  for (const [index, row] of rows.entries()) {
    if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') {
      errors.push({ row: index + 1, reason: 'La fila debe contener un objeto con nombre, unidad y costo.' });
      continue;
    }

    const candidate = row as Record<string, unknown>;
    const name = String(candidate.name ?? candidate.nombre ?? '').trim();
    const unit = String(candidate.unit ?? candidate.unidad ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const rawCost = candidate.cost ?? candidate.costo ?? candidate.currentCost;
    const normalizedName = name.toLowerCase();

    const validationErrors: string[] = [];

    if (!name) {
      validationErrors.push('El campo "name" es obligatorio y debe ser un texto no vacío.');
    }

    if (!VALID_UNITS.includes(unit as Unit)) {
      validationErrors.push(`El campo "unit" debe ser uno de: ${VALID_UNITS.join(', ')}.`);
    }

    let parsedCost: Prisma.Decimal | null = null;
    if (rawCost === undefined || rawCost === null || (typeof rawCost === 'string' && rawCost.trim() === '')) {
      validationErrors.push('El campo "cost" es obligatorio.');
    } else {
      try {
        const decimalValue = parseArgentineDecimal(rawCost, 'cost');
        if (decimalValue.lessThanOrEqualTo(0)) {
          validationErrors.push('El campo "cost" debe ser mayor a cero.');
        } else if (decimalValue.decimalPlaces() > 2) {
          validationErrors.push('El campo "cost" debe ser un valor decimal válido (ej: "742.98").');
        } else if (decimalValue.abs().greaterThan(MAX_MONEY_VALUE)) {
          validationErrors.push('El insumo no puede superar $99.999.999,99.');
        } else {
          parsedCost = decimalValue;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        validationErrors.push((error as Error).message || 'El campo "cost" debe ser un valor decimal válido.');
      }
    }

    if (validationErrors.length > 0) {
      errors.push({ row: index + 1, reason: validationErrors.join(' ') });
      continue;
    }

    if (existingNames.has(normalizedName) || seenInBatch.has(normalizedName)) {
      skipped += 1;
      continue;
    }

    validRows.push({ name, searchName: normalizeSearchText(name), unit: unit as Unit, cost: parsedCost! });
    seenInBatch.add(normalizedName);
  }

  const transactionResult = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    for (const item of validRows) {
      await tx.ingredient.create({
        data: {
          name: item.name,
          searchName: item.searchName,
          unit: item.unit,
          currentCost: item.cost,
          accountId,
        },
      });
    }

    return validRows.length;
  });

  return res.status(200).json({
    created: transactionResult,
    skipped,
    errors,
  });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* PUT /api/ingredients/:id                                            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.put('/:id', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  if (!req.is('application/json')) {
    throw new AppError('El header Content-Type debe ser application/json.', 400);
  }

  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const existing = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    select: { id: true, name: true, unit: true, currentCost: true },
  });

  if (!existing) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const { name, unit, currentCost } = parseIngredientInput(req.body as IngredientInputDTO);
  const nextCost = new Prisma.Decimal(currentCost.toString());
  const previousCostForComparison = existing.currentCost ?? new Prisma.Decimal(0);
  const hasNoActualChange =
    previousCostForComparison.equals(nextCost) && existing.name === name && existing.unit === unit;

  if (name.toLowerCase() !== existing.name.toLowerCase()) {
    const duplicate = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
      where: { accountId, name: { equals: name, mode: 'insensitive' } },
    });
    if (duplicate) {
      throw new AppError('Ya existe un insumo con ese nombre.', 409);
    }
  }

  if (hasNoActualChange) {
    return res.status(200).json({
      ingredient: existing,
      affectedProductsCount: 0,
      affectedProducts: [],
      criticalProducts: [],
    });
  }

  const previousCost = existing.currentCost ?? null;

  const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const ingredient = await tx.ingredient.update({
      where: { id },
      omit: { searchName: true },
      data: { name, searchName: normalizeSearchText(name), unit, currentCost: nextCost },
    });

    const { affectedProductsCount, affectedProducts, criticalProducts } = await applyIngredientCostChange(tx, id, previousCost, nextCost);

    return { ingredient, affectedProductsCount, affectedProducts, criticalProducts };
  });

  if (result.criticalProducts.length > 0) {
    void dispatchMarginAlertEvent({
      accountId,
      ingredientId: id,
      ingredientName: name,
      affectedProductsCount: result.affectedProductsCount,
      criticalProducts: result.criticalProducts.map((product) => ({
        productId: product.productId,
        productName: product.productName,
        previousCost: product.previousCost.toFixed(2),
        newCost: product.newCost.toFixed(2),
        currentMarginPercent: product.currentMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
        minMarginPercent: product.minMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
      })),
    });
  }

  return res.status(200).json({
    ingredient: result.ingredient,
    affectedProductsCount: result.affectedProductsCount,
    affectedProducts: result.affectedProducts.map((product) => ({
      productId: product.productId,
      productName: product.productName,
      previousCost: product.previousCost.toFixed(2),
      newCost: product.newCost.toFixed(2),
      currentMarginPercent: product.currentMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
      minMarginPercent: product.minMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
    })),
    criticalProducts: result.criticalProducts.map((product) => ({
      productId: product.productId,
      productName: product.productName,
      previousCost: product.previousCost.toFixed(2),
      newCost: product.newCost.toFixed(2),
      currentMarginPercent: product.currentMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
      minMarginPercent: product.minMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
    })),
  });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* DELETE /api/ingredients/:id                                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.delete('/:id', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const existing = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  if (!existing) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const usages = await prisma.productIngredient.findMany({
    where: { ingredientId: id },
    select: {
      product: {
        select: { id: true, name: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (usages.length > 0) {
    return res.status(409).json({
      error: 'No se puede eliminar el insumo porque forma parte de una o más recetas activas.',
      productsAffected: usages.map((u) => u.product),
    });
  }

  await prisma.ingredient.delete({ where: { id } });

  return res.status(200).json({ message: 'Insumo eliminado correctamente.' });
});

export default router;
</file>

<file path="backend/src/routes/products.test.ts">
// src/routes/products.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import express from 'express';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

import type { AuthenticatedRequest } from '../middlewares/auth';
import type { Response, NextFunction } from 'express';

let currentUserRole: 'ADMIN' | 'COLLABORATOR' = 'ADMIN';

vi.mock('../middlewares/auth', () => ({
  authMiddleware: (req: AuthenticatedRequest, _res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    req.user = { id: 'user-1', accountId: 'account-1', email: 'a@a.com', role: currentUserRole };
    next();
  },
}));

const productFindManyMock = vi.fn();
const productCountMock = vi.fn();
const productFindFirstMock = vi.fn();
const productDeleteManyMock = vi.fn();

const txIngredientFindManyMock = vi.fn();
const txProductCreateMock = vi.fn();
const txProductFindFirstMock = vi.fn();
const txProductUpdateMock = vi.fn();
const txProductIngredientDeleteManyMock = vi.fn();
const txProductIngredientCountMock = vi.fn();

vi.mock('../lib/prisma', () => ({
  prisma: {
    product: {
      findMany: (...args: unknown[]) => productFindManyMock(...args),
      count: (...args: unknown[]) => productCountMock(...args),
      findFirst: (...args: unknown[]) => productFindFirstMock(...args),
      deleteMany: (...args: unknown[]) => productDeleteManyMock(...args),
    },
    $transaction: async <T>(fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<T>) => {
      const tx = {
        ingredient: {
          findMany: (...args: unknown[]) => txIngredientFindManyMock(...args),
        },
        product: {
          create: (...args: unknown[]) => txProductCreateMock(...args),
          findFirst: (...args: unknown[]) => txProductFindFirstMock(...args),
          update: (...args: unknown[]) => txProductUpdateMock(...args),
        },
        productIngredient: {
          deleteMany: (...args: unknown[]) => txProductIngredientDeleteManyMock(...args),
          count: (...args: unknown[]) => txProductIngredientCountMock(...args),
        },
      };
      return fn(tx);
    },
  },
}));

import productsRouter from './products';
import { errorHandler } from '../middlewares/errorHandler';

function buildApp() {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/products', productsRouter);
  app.use(errorHandler);
  return app;
}

function setAuthRole(role: 'ADMIN' | 'COLLABORATOR') {
  currentUserRole = role;
}

beforeEach(() => {
  setAuthRole('ADMIN');
  productFindManyMock.mockReset();
  productCountMock.mockReset();
  productFindFirstMock.mockReset();
  productDeleteManyMock.mockReset();
  txIngredientFindManyMock.mockReset();
  txProductCreateMock.mockReset();
  txProductFindFirstMock.mockReset();
  txProductUpdateMock.mockReset();
  txProductIngredientDeleteManyMock.mockReset();
  txProductIngredientCountMock.mockReset();
});

/** Forma de los datos que el router pasa a `product.update({ data })`. */
interface ProductUpdateData {
  name?: Prisma.Decimal | string;
  searchName?: string;
  salePrice: Prisma.Decimal;
  minMarginPercent: Prisma.Decimal;
  cost: Prisma.Decimal;
  marginAmount: Prisma.Decimal;
  marginPercent: Prisma.Decimal;
}

/**
 * Devuelve el `data` de la primera llamada a product.update, fallando el
 * test con un mensaje claro si nunca se llamó. Evita el error 2532 de
 * `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` sin recurrir a `!` en cada aserción.
 */
function firstUpdateData(): ProductUpdateData {
  const call = txProductUpdateMock.mock.calls[0];
  expect(call).toBeDefined();
  return (call as [{ data: ProductUpdateData }])[0].data;
}

describe('schema Prisma y migración', () => {
  // Recorre todas las migraciones en orden, no solo la última: así la prueba no se
  // rompe cuando se agrega una migración nueva, pero sí falla si alguna posterior
  // borra los índices (por ejemplo, un `prisma migrate dev` que no los conoce).
  const migrationDir = join(__dirname, '../../prisma/migrations');
  const allMigrationsSql = readdirSync(migrationDir, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory())
    .map((entry) => entry.name)
    .sort()
    .map((dir) => readFileSync(join(migrationDir, dir, 'migration.sql'), 'utf8'))
    .join('\n');

  it.each(['Product', 'Supplier', 'Ingredient'])(
    'crea el índice único (accountId, lower(name)) de %s y ninguna migración posterior lo borra',
    (model) => {
      const indexName = `${model}_accountId_lower_name_key`;
      const createSql = `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "${indexName}" ON "${model}"("accountId", lower("name"));`;

      const createdAt = allMigrationsSql.lastIndexOf(createSql);
      expect(createdAt).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      expect(allMigrationsSql.indexOf(`DROP INDEX "${indexName}"`, createdAt)).toBe(-1);
      expect(allMigrationsSql.indexOf(`DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "${indexName}"`, createdAt)).toBe(-1);
    }
  );

  it('la auditoría previa de duplicados cubre las tres tablas y es de solo lectura', () => {
    const auditSql = readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../prisma/sql/auditar-nombres-duplicados.sql'), 'utf8');
    const statements = auditSql
      .split('\n')
      .filter((line) => !line.trimStart().startsWith('--'))
      .join('\n');

    for (const model of ['Supplier', 'Ingredient', 'Product']) {
      expect(statements).toContain(`FROM "${model}" t`);
    }
    expect(statements.match(/GROUP BY a\.slug, lower\(t\."name"\) HAVING count\(\*\) > 1/g)).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(statements).not.toMatch(/\b(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|ALTER|TRUNCATE|CREATE)\b/i);
  });

  it('documenta en schema.prisma que la unicidad case-insensitive vive en la migración SQL', () => {
    const schema = readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../prisma/schema.prisma'), 'utf8');

    expect(schema).toContain('La unicidad case-insensitive por cuenta se garantiza con el índice funcional UNIQUE');
    for (const model of ['Product', 'Supplier', 'Ingredient']) {
      expect(schema).toContain(
        `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "${model}_accountId_lower_name_key" ON "${model}"("accountId", lower("name"));`
      );
    }
  });

  it('todos los seeds y rutas de alta/edición completan searchName usando normalizeSearchText', () => {
    const seedFiles = ['seed.ts', 'seed-demo.ts', 'seed-volumen.ts'];
    for (const file of seedFiles) {
      const content = readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../prisma', file), 'utf8');
      expect(content, `${file} debe importar normalizeSearchText`).toContain('normalizeSearchText');
      expect(content, `${file} debe completar searchName`).toContain('searchName:');
    }

    const volumen = readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../prisma/seed-volumen.ts'), 'utf8');
    expect(volumen.match(/searchName:\s*normalizeSearchText\(/g)).toHaveLength(4);
  });
});

describe('GET /api/products - paginación', () => {
  it('devuelve data y meta correctos con page/limit/sortBy/order válidos', async () => {
    productFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue(new Array(2).fill({ id: 'p1', name: 'Prod' }));
    productCountMock.mockResolvedValue(5);

    const res = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/products?page=1&limit=2&sortBy=name&order=desc');

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(res.body.meta).toEqual({ total: 5, page: 1, limit: 2, totalPages: 3 });
    expect(productFindManyMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        where: { accountId: 'account-1' },
        orderBy: { name: 'desc' },
        skip: 0,
        take: 2,
      })
    );
  });
});

describe('GET /api/products - Búsqueda por nombre (search)', () => {
  it('aplica la condición OR con variantes diacríticas cuando se envía search', async () => {
    productFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([
      {
        id: 'p-1',
        name: 'Medialunas de manteca',
        salePrice: new Prisma.Decimal('13500.00'),
        cost: new Prisma.Decimal('3616.25'),
        marginAmount: new Prisma.Decimal('9883.75'),
        marginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('73.21'),
        minMarginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('65.00'),
        ingredients: [],
      },
    ]);
    productCountMock.mockResolvedValue(1);

    const res = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/products?search=medialuna');

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(res.body.data[0].name).toBe('Medialunas de manteca');
    expect(res.body.meta.total).toBe(1);

    expect(productFindManyMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        where: expect.objectContaining({
          accountId: 'account-1',
          OR: [
            { searchName: { contains: 'medialuna', mode: 'insensitive' } },
            { name: { contains: 'medialuna', mode: 'insensitive' } },
          ],
        }),
      })
    );
    expect(productCountMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      where: expect.objectContaining({
        accountId: 'account-1',
        OR: [
          { searchName: { contains: 'medialuna', mode: 'insensitive' } },
          { name: { contains: 'medialuna', mode: 'insensitive' } },
        ],
      }),
    });
  });

  it('encuentra productos reales buscando sin tildes ("jabon liquido", "canoncitos", "pan de campo")', async () => {
    const cases = [
      { search: 'pan de campo', name: 'Pan de Campo', normalized: 'pan de campo' },
      { search: 'jabon liquido', name: 'Jabón líquido (Ariel/Skip/Ace) — 1 L', normalized: 'jabon liquido' },
      { search: 'canoncitos', name: 'Cañoncitos con dulce de leche', normalized: 'canoncitos' },
    ];

    for (const c of cases) {
      productFindManyMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([
        { id: 'p-c', name: c.name, searchName: c.normalized, salePrice: new Prisma.Decimal('1000') },
      ]);
      productCountMock.mockResolvedValueOnce(1);

      const res = await request(buildApp()).get(`/api/products?search=${encodeURIComponent(c.search)}`);
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.data[0].name).toBe(c.name);
    }
  });

  it('combina search con page, limit, sortBy y order', async () => {
    productFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([]);
    productCountMock.mockResolvedValue(0);

    const res = await request(buildApp()).get(
      '/api/products?search=pan&page=2&limit=5&sortBy=salePrice&order=desc'
    );

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(productFindManyMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        where: expect.objectContaining({
          accountId: 'account-1',
          OR: expect.any(Array),
        }),
        orderBy: { salePrice: 'desc' },
        skip: 5,
        take: 5,
      })
    );
    expect(res.body.meta).toEqual({ total: 0, page: 2, limit: 5, totalPages: 0 });
  });

  it('Escenario Aislamiento: la búsqueda no filtra productos de otra cuenta', async () => {
    productFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([]);
    productCountMock.mockResolvedValue(0);

    const res = await request(buildApp()).get('/api/products?search=Detergente');

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(productFindManyMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        where: expect.objectContaining({
          accountId: 'account-1', // Aislamiento garantizado por el token
        }),
      })
    );
  });

  it('Sanitización RBAC: un COLLABORATOR puede buscar pero no recibe costos ni márgenes', async () => {
    setAuthRole('COLLABORATOR');

    productFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([
      {
        id: 'p-1',
        name: 'Pan de Campo',
        salePrice: new Prisma.Decimal('4500.00'),
        cost: new Prisma.Decimal('1800.00'),
        marginAmount: new Prisma.Decimal('2700.00'),
        marginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('60.00'),
        minMarginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('40.00'),
        ingredients: [{ ingredientId: 'ing-1', quantity: new Prisma.Decimal('1.000') }],
      },
    ]);
    productCountMock.mockResolvedValue(1);

    const res = await request(buildApp())
      .get('/api/products?search=campo')
      .set('x-role', 'COLLABORATOR');

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data[0].name).toBe('Pan de Campo');
    expect(res.body.data[0].salePrice).toBe('4500');
    // Campos purgados por sanitizeFinancialData
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('cost');
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('marginAmount');
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('marginPercent');
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('minMarginPercent');
  });
});

describe('POST /api/products', () => {
  it('crea un producto calculando costo y márgenes cuando hay receta', async () => {
    txIngredientFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([
      { id: 'ing-1', currentCost: new Prisma.Decimal('10') },
    ]);
    txProductCreateMock.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'p1', name: 'Prod', cost: '20.00' });

    const payload = {
      name: 'Prod',
      salePrice: '30.00',
      minMarginPercent: '10',
      ingredients: [{ ingredientId: 'ing-1', quantity: '2' }],
    };

    const res = await request(buildApp()).post('/api/products').send(payload);

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.product).toEqual({ id: 'p1', name: 'Prod', cost: '20.00' });
    expect(txIngredientFindManyMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ where: { accountId: 'account-1', id: { in: ['ing-1'] } } })
    );
  });
  it('permite salePrice = 0 en un producto borrador sin receta', async () => {
    txIngredientFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([]);
    txProductCreateMock.mockResolvedValue({
      id: 'p-borrador',
      name: 'Producto borrador',
      cost: '0.00',
      marginAmount: '0.00',
      marginPercent: '0.00',
    });

    const payload = {
      name: 'Producto borrador',
      salePrice: '0',
      minMarginPercent: '0',
      ingredients: [],
    };

    const res = await request(buildApp()).post('/api/products').send(payload);

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.product.marginAmount).toBe('0.00');
    expect(res.body.product.marginPercent).toBe('0.00');

    const createCall = txProductCreateMock.mock.calls[0] as [{
      data: {
        salePrice: Prisma.Decimal;
        cost: Prisma.Decimal;
        marginAmount: Prisma.Decimal;
        marginPercent: Prisma.Decimal;
      };
    }];
    const createData = createCall[0].data;

    expect(createData.salePrice.toString()).toBe('0');
    expect(createData.cost.toString()).toBe('0');
    expect(createData.marginAmount.toString()).toBe('0');
    expect(createData.marginPercent.toString()).toBe('0');
  });

  it('rechaza salePrice = 0 cuando el producto tiene receta', async () => {
    txIngredientFindManyMock.mockResolvedValue([
      { id: 'ing-1', currentCost: new Prisma.Decimal('1500') },
    ]);

    const res = await request(buildApp())
      .post('/api/products')
      .send({
        name: 'Producto con receta y precio cero',
        salePrice: '0',
        minMarginPercent: '0',
        ingredients: [{ ingredientId: 'ing-1', quantity: '1' }],
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toMatch(/precio de venta debe ser mayor a cero/i);
    expect(txProductCreateMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('PUT rechaza salePrice = 0 cuando el producto conserva la receta', async () => {
    txProductFindFirstMock.mockResolvedValue({
      id: 'p1',
      name: 'Prod',
      salePrice: new Prisma.Decimal('30.00'),
      minMarginPercent: new Prisma.Decimal('10'),
      cost: new Prisma.Decimal('20.00'),
      marginAmount: new Prisma.Decimal('10.00'),
